     1→# CLAUDE.md
     2→
     3→This file provides guidance to coding agents when working with code in this repository.
     4→
     5→## Project Overview
     6→
     7→SpecStory CLI is a wrapper for coding agents that tracks conversations and generates markdown files. The project uses the Go language and follows standard Go project conventions.
     8→
     9→## Key Commands
    10→
    11→### Building
    12→
    13→The command is always built as `specstory`, located in the root of the repository.
    14→
    15→```zsh
    16→# Build for current platform
    17→go build -o specstory
    18→```
    19→
    20→### Testing
    21→
    22→```zsh
    23→# Run all tests
    24→go test ./...
    25→
    26→# Run tests with verbose output
    27→go test -v ./...
    28→
    29→# Run tests for specific package
    30→go test -v ./pkg/cli
    31→go test -v ./pkg/utils
    32→
    33→# Run specific test
    34→go test -v -run TestGenerateFilename ./pkg/utils
    35→```
    36→
    37→### Linting
    38→
    39→Don't try linting individual files. This often fails with noise in Go Lang, just lint the whole project, it's fast.
    40→
    41→```zsh
    42→# Run linter
    43→golangci-lint run
    44→
    45→# Format code
    46→gofmt -w .
    47→```
    48→
    49→### Running the CLI
    50→
    51→There are two main modes of operation:
    52→
    53→```zsh
    54→# Interactive interactive auto-save mode
    55→./specstory run
    56→
    57→# Sync mode - process all sessions
    58→./specstory sync
    59→
    60→# Sync mode - process specific session
    61→./specstory sync -u <uuid>
    62→```
    63→
    64→### Debugging
    65→
    66→To see debug output, you can use the following commands:
    67→
    68→```zsh
    69→# Debug output to stdout
    70→./specstory sync --debug
    71→
    72→# Debug log output in ./.specstory/debug/debug.log
    73→./specstory sync --log
    74→
    75→# Hidden debug flag (not in public docs)
    76→./specstory sync --debug-raw          # Debug mode to output pretty-printed raw data files
    77→```
    78→
    79→## Technical Details
    80→
    81→### Code Structure
    82→
    83→The codebase package structure:
    84→
    85→- `main.go` - CLI entry point
    86→- `pkg/analytics/` - PostHog analytics integration
    87→- `pkg/cloud` - Cloud sync integration
    88→- `pkg/cmd` - CLI commands and command parsing
    89→- `pkg/config` - Optional TOML config file handling
    90→- `pkg/log/` - Logging utilities
    91→- `pkg/provenance/` - Optional AI provenance tracking
    92→- `pkg/providers/*` - Provider implementations including file watching, data processing, and session data generation
    93→- `pkg/session/` - Session data validation, helpers and markdown generation
    94→- `pkg/spi/` - SPI implementation for provider implementations
    95→- `pkg/utils/` - Helper functions
    96→
    97→### JSONL File Behavior
    98→
    99→- Session data files grow during conversation (append-only)
   100→- `run` and `watch` commands uses fsnotify for real-time monitoring of the agent's session data directory
   101→- Many agents (e.g. Claude Code) use JSONL files for session data (e.g. `~/.claude/projects/<dir-derived-from-project-dir>/<session-id>.jsonl`)
   102→
   103→### Analytics Events
   104→
   105→When adding new features, track usage with PostHog:
   106→
   107→```go
   108→analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventExtensionActivated, analytics.Properties{
   109→	"property": "value",
   110→})
   111→```
   112→
   113→## Code Conventions
   114→
   115→- Write only idomatic Go code.
   116→- Prioritize simplicity and readability over terse or clever code
   117→- Emphasize DRY code, look for existing code that can be reused, don't just write new code first.
   118→- Use Go lang libraries, not external dependencies where possible, if a dependency is needed explain why
   119→- Comment everything that's not obvious, if in doubt, comment it.
   120→- Use "Why" comments, not "what" or "how" unless specifically requested
   121→- Use single function exit point where possible (immediate guard clauses are OK)
   122→- Provide consistent observability and tracing with log/slog for logging, not fmt.Println or fmt.Printf
   123→- Follow existing patterns in the codebase
   124→- The application doesn't support Windows, only Linux and macOS, don't include Windows support in the codebase.
   125→
   126→## Testing Strategy & Conventions
   127→
   128→- Tests use Go's standard `testing` package
   129→- Write unit tests for things with complicated logic
   130→- Don't write unit tests for simple, tautological things
   131→- Test files follow Go convention: *_test.go alongside source files in the same package
   132→- Table-driven tests: tests are structured with test cases defined in slices of structs
   133→  - Each struct contains: name, input parameters, and expected results
   134→  - Uses t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {...}) for subtests
   135→- Use clear test function naming: TestFunctionName or TestFunctionName_Scenario
   136→- Make manual assertions using t.Errorf()
   137→- Unit Tests: Most tests focus on individual functions
   138→- Edge Case Testing: Comprehensive coverage of error conditions, empty inputs, invalid data
   139→- Integration-style Tests: Some tests like TestSessionProcessingFlow test multiple components together
   140→- Tests both success and failure paths
   141→- Validates error messages contain expected strings
   142→- Test permission errors, missing files, invalid inputs
   143→
   144→## Writing Conventions
   145→
   146→- Never put text immediately after the header in markdown, put in a newline first.
   147→- Use `zsh` code blocks in markdown (not `bash`)
   148→- Keep the repository `README.md` up to date with the latest changes.
   149→- When planning, never write time/calendar estimates into documents.
   150→
   151→## Development Workflow
   152→
   153→When searching for code, ALWAYS exclude the `.specstory` directory.
   154→
   155→Don't just make your own decision, explain the options, the pros and cons, and what you recommend. Have the user make the decision.
   156→
   157→Don't ever respond with just code changes. Always include explanations of what you're doing, why you're doing it, and how.
   158→
   159→Always ask before introducing any new dependencies.
   160→
   161→Always ask before introducing any new code files.
   162→
   163→Run the linter after every code change `golangci-lint run`. Fix formatting errors yourself with `gofmt -w .`.
   164→
   165→Run tests after every major code change `go test -v ./...`.
   166→
   167→Don't just run commands, explain what you're doing and why.
```

    22→// AgentChatSession represents a chat session from an AI coding agent

    25→	CreatedAt   string              // Stable ISO 8601 timestamp when session was created
    26→	Slug        string              // Stable human-readable but file name safe slug, often derived from first user message
    27→	SessionData *schema.SessionData // Structured session data in unified format

    30→
    31→// SessionMetadata contains lightweight metadata about a session without full content
    32→// Used by ListAgentChatSessions for efficient session listing
    33→type SessionMetadata struct {
    34→	SessionID string `json:"session_id" csv:"session_id"` // Stable and unique identifier for the session
    35→	CreatedAt string `json:"created_at" csv:"created_at"` // Stable ISO 8601 timestamp when session was created
    36→	Slug      string `json:"slug" csv:"slug"`             // Stable human-readable session name/slug
    37→	Name      string `json:"name" csv:"name"`             // Human-readable description of the session (may be empty if not available)
    38→}
    39→
    40→// Provider defines the interface that all agent coding tool providers must implement
    41→type Provider interface {
    42→	// Name returns the human-readable name of the provider (e.g., "Claude Code", "Cursor CLI", "Codex CLI")
    43→	Name() string
    44→
    45→	// Check verifies if the provider is properly installed and returns version info
    46→	// customCommand: empty string = use detected/default binary path, non-empty = use this specific command/path
    47→	Check(customCommand string) CheckResult
    48→
    49→	// DetectAgent checks if the provider's agent has been used in the given project path
    50→	// projectPath: Agent's working directory
    51→	// helpOutput: if true AND no activity is found, the provider should output helpful guidance
    52→	// Returns true if the agent has created artifacts/sessions in the specified path
    53→	DetectAgent(projectPath string, helpOutput bool) bool
    54→
    55→	// GetAgentChatSession retrieves a single chat session by ID for the given project path
    56→	// projectPath: Agent's working directory
    57→	// sessionID: specific session identifier to retrieve (always provided, never empty)
    58→	// debugRaw: if true, provider should write provider-specific raw debug files to .specstory/debug/<sessionID>/

    60→	// Returns nil if the session is not found, error for actual errors
    61→	GetAgentChatSession(projectPath string, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*AgentChatSession, error)
    62→
    63→	// GetAgentChatSessions retrieves all chat sessions for the given project path
    64→	// projectPath: Agent's working directory
    65→	// debugRaw: if true, provider should write provider-specific raw debug files to .specstory/debug/<sessionID>/
    66→	//           (e.g., numbered JSON files). The unified session-data.json is written centrally by the CLI.
    67→	// progress: optional callback for reporting progress during parsing (nil = no progress reporting)

    70→
    71→	// ListAgentChatSessions retrieves lightweight metadata for all sessions without full parsing
    72→	// This should be faster than GetAgentChatSessions as it only needs to return SessionMetadata and not the full AgentChatSession
    73→	// projectPath: Agent's working directory
    74→	// Returns a slice of SessionMetadata (ordering is provider-defined; consumers will sort if needed)
    75→	ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]SessionMetadata, error)
    76→
    77→	// ExecAgentAndWatch executes the agent in interactive mode and watches for session updates
    78→	// Blocks until the agent exits, calling sessionCallback for each new/updated session
    79→	// projectPath: Agent's working directory
    80→	// customCommand: empty string = use detected/default binary with default args, non-empty = use this specific command/path
    81→	// resumeSessionID: empty string = start new session, non-empty = resume this specific session ID
    82→	// debugRaw: if true, provider should write provider-specific raw debug files to .specstory/debug/<sessionID>/

     1→// Package factory provides the provider registry and factory implementation.
     2→// This package imports all concrete provider implementations and manages
     3→// their registration, avoiding circular dependencies in the SPI layer.
     4→package factory
     5→
     6→import (
     7→	"fmt"
     8→	"log/slog"
     9→	"sort"
    10→	"strings"
    11→	"sync"
    12→
    13→	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/providers/claudecode"
    14→	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/providers/codexcli"
    15→	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/providers/cursorcli"
    16→	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/providers/droidcli"
    17→	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/providers/geminicli"
    18→	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
    19→)
    20→
    21→// Registry manages all registered providers
    22→type Registry struct {
    23→	providers         map[string]spi.Provider // key is the provider ID (e.g., "claude", "cursor")
    24→	mu                sync.RWMutex
    25→	initialized       bool
    26→	providerListCache string    // Cached formatted provider list string
    27→	providerListOnce  sync.Once // Ensures provider list is built only once
    28→}
    29→
    30→// Global registry instance
    31→var (
    32→	registry = &Registry{
    33→		providers: make(map[string]spi.Provider),
    34→	}
    35→	once sync.Once
    36→)
    37→
    38→// ensureInitialized makes sure providers are registered
    39→func (r *Registry) ensureInitialized() {
    40→	once.Do(func() {
    41→		r.registerAll()
    42→	})
    43→}
    44→
    45→// registerAll registers all known providers.
    46→// This is the ONLY place that needs to be updated when adding new providers.
    47→func (r *Registry) registerAll() {
    48→	r.mu.Lock()
    49→	defer r.mu.Unlock()
    50→
    51→	if r.initialized {
    52→		slog.Debug("Provider registry already initialized, skipping registration")
    53→		return
    54→	}
    55→
    56→	slog.Debug("Initializing provider registry")
    57→
    58→	// Register providers with simple IDs
    59→	// Each provider directly implements the spi.Provider interface
    60→	claudeProvider := claudecode.NewProvider()
    61→	r.providers["claude"] = claudeProvider
    62→	slog.Debug("Registered provider", "id", "claude", "name", claudeProvider.Name())
    63→
    64→	cursorProvider := cursorcli.NewProvider()
    65→	r.providers["cursor"] = cursorProvider
    66→	slog.Debug("Registered provider", "id", "cursor", "name", cursorProvider.Name())
    67→
    68→	codexProvider := codexcli.NewProvider()
    69→	r.providers["codex"] = codexProvider
    70→	slog.Debug("Registered provider", "id", "codex", "name", codexProvider.Name())
    71→
    72→	geminiProvider := geminicli.NewProvider()
    73→	r.providers["gemini"] = geminiProvider
    74→	slog.Debug("Registered provider", "id", "gemini", "name", geminiProvider.Name())
    75→
    76→	droidProvider := droidcli.NewProvider()
    77→	r.providers["droid"] = droidProvider
    78→	slog.Debug("Registered provider", "id", "droid", "name", droidProvider.Name())
    79→
    80→	r.initialized = true
    81→	slog.Info("Provider registry initialized", "count", len(r.providers), "providers", r.ListIDsUnsafe())
    82→}
    83→
    84→// ListIDsUnsafe returns provider IDs without locking (for internal use only)
    85→func (r *Registry) ListIDsUnsafe() []string {
    86→	ids := make([]string, 0, len(r.providers))
    87→	for id := range r.providers {
    88→		ids = append(ids, id)
    89→	}
    90→	sort.Strings(ids)
    91→	return ids
    92→}
    93→
    94→// GetRegistry returns the global registry instance
    95→func GetRegistry() *Registry {
    96→	registry.ensureInitialized()
    97→	return registry
    98→}
    99→
   100→// Get retrieves a provider by ID (case-insensitive)
   101→func (r *Registry) Get(id string) (spi.Provider, error) {
   102→	r.ensureInitialized()
   103→	r.mu.RLock()
   104→	defer r.mu.RUnlock()
   105→
   106→	// Case-insensitive lookup
   107→	for provID, provider := range r.providers {
   108→		if strings.EqualFold(provID, id) {
   109→			slog.Debug("Retrieved provider", "requested_id", id, "matched_id", provID, "name", provider.Name())
   110→			return provider, nil
   111→		}
   112→	}
   113→
   114→	// Log available providers when lookup fails to aid debugging
   115→	availableIDs := make([]string, 0, len(r.providers))
   116→	for id := range r.providers {
   117→		availableIDs = append(availableIDs, id)
   118→	}
   119→	sort.Strings(availableIDs)
   120→
   121→	slog.Warn("Provider not found",
   122→		"requested_id", id,
   123→		"available_providers", availableIDs)
   124→
   125→	return nil, fmt.Errorf("provider '%s' not found", id)
   126→}
   127→
   128→// GetAll returns all registered providers as a map of ID to Provider
   129→func (r *Registry) GetAll() map[string]spi.Provider {
   130→	r.ensureInitialized()
   131→	r.mu.RLock()
   132→	defer r.mu.RUnlock()
   133→
   134→	// Return a copy to prevent external modification
   135→	result := make(map[string]spi.Provider)
   136→	for id, provider := range r.providers {
   137→		result[id] = provider
   138→	}
   139→
   140→	return result
   141→}
   142→
   143→// ListIDs returns all registered provider IDs (sorted)
   144→func (r *Registry) ListIDs() []string {
   145→	r.ensureInitialized()
   146→	r.mu.RLock()
   147→	defer r.mu.RUnlock()
   148→
   149→	ids := make([]string, 0, len(r.providers))
   150→	for id := range r.providers {
   151→		ids = append(ids, id)
   152→	}
   153→
   154→	sort.Strings(ids)
   155→	return ids
   156→}
   157→
   158→// GetDefault returns the default provider (Claude)
   159→func (r *Registry) GetDefault() (spi.Provider, error) {
   160→	r.ensureInitialized()
   161→	slog.Debug("Getting default provider (claude)")
   162→	return r.Get("claude")
   163→}
   164→
   165→// GetProviderList returns a formatted string listing all providers.
   166→// Used for help text and error messages.
   167→// The result is cached since providers are static for the lifetime of the process.
   168→func (r *Registry) GetProviderList() string {
   169→	r.ensureInitialized()
   170→
   171→	// Build the provider list only once and cache it
   172→	r.providerListOnce.Do(func() {
   173→		r.mu.RLock()
   174→		defer r.mu.RUnlock()
   175→
   176→		if len(r.providers) == 0 {
   177→			r.providerListCache = "No providers registered"
   178→			return
   179→		}
   180→
   181→		// Get sorted IDs for consistent ordering
   182→		ids := make([]string, 0, len(r.providers))
   183→		for id := range r.providers {
   184→			ids = append(ids, id)
   185→		}
   186→		sort.Strings(ids)
   187→
   188→		// Build the formatted list by accessing providers directly (no Get() calls)
   189→		var parts []string
   190→		for _, id := range ids {
   191→			if provider, ok := r.providers[id]; ok {
   192→				parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s)", id, provider.Name()))
   193→			}
   194→		}
   195→
   196→		r.providerListCache = strings.Join(parts, ", ")
   197→	})
   198→
   199→	return r.providerListCache
   200→}
   201→

    22→// Provider implements the SPI Provider interface for Claude Code
    23→type Provider struct{}

    25→// NewProvider creates a new Claude Code provider instance
    26→func NewProvider() *Provider {
    27→	return &Provider{}
    28→}
    29→
    30→// filterWarmupMessages removes warmup messages (sidechain messages before first real message)
    31→func filterWarmupMessages(records []JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
    32→	// Find first non-sidechain message
    33→	firstRealMessageIndex := -1
    34→	for i, record := range records {
    35→		if isSidechain, ok := record.Data["isSidechain"].(bool); !ok || !isSidechain {
    36→			firstRealMessageIndex = i
    37→			break
    38→		}
    39→	}
    40→
    41→	// No real messages found
    42→	if firstRealMessageIndex == -1 {
    43→		return []JSONLRecord{}
    44→	}
    45→
    46→	// Return records starting from first real message
    47→	return records[firstRealMessageIndex:]
    48→}
    49→
    50→// processSession filters warmup messages and converts a Session to an AgentChatSession
    51→// Returns nil if the session is warmup-only (no real messages)
    52→func processSession(session Session, workspaceRoot string, debugRaw bool) *spi.AgentChatSession {
    53→	// Write debug files first (even for warmup-only sessions)
    54→	if debugRaw {
    55→		// Write debug files and get the record-to-file mapping
    56→		_ = writeDebugRawFiles(session) // Unused but needed for side effect
    57→	}
    58→
    59→	// Filter warmup messages
    60→	filteredRecords := filterWarmupMessages(session.Records)
    61→
    62→	// Skip if no real messages remain after filtering warmup
    63→	if len(filteredRecords) == 0 {
    64→		slog.Debug("Skipping warmup-only session", "sessionId", session.SessionUuid)
    65→		return nil
    66→	}
    67→
    68→	// Create session with filtered records
    69→	filteredSession := Session{
    70→		SessionUuid: session.SessionUuid,
    71→		Records:     filteredRecords,
    72→	}
    73→
    74→	// Get timestamp from root record
    75→	rootRecord := filteredSession.Records[0]
    76→	timestamp := rootRecord.Data["timestamp"].(string)
    77→
    78→	// Get the slug
    79→	slug := FileSlugFromRootRecord(filteredSession)
    80→
    81→	// Generate SessionData from filtered session
    82→	sessionData, err := GenerateAgentSession(filteredSession, workspaceRoot)
    83→	if err != nil {
    84→		slog.Error("Failed to generate SessionData", "sessionId", session.SessionUuid, "error", err)
    85→		return nil
    86→	}
    87→
    88→	// Convert session records to JSONL format for raw data
    89→	// Note: Uses unfiltered session.Records (not filteredSession.Records) to preserve
    90→	// all records including warmup messages in the raw data for complete audit trail
    91→	var rawDataBuilder strings.Builder
    92→	for _, record := range session.Records {
    93→		jsonBytes, _ := json.Marshal(record.Data)
    94→		rawDataBuilder.Write(jsonBytes)
    95→		rawDataBuilder.WriteString("\n")
    96→	}
    97→
    98→	return &spi.AgentChatSession{
    99→		SessionID:   session.SessionUuid,
   100→		CreatedAt:   timestamp, // ISO 8601 timestamp
   101→		Slug:        slug,
   102→		SessionData: sessionData,
   103→		RawData:     rawDataBuilder.String(),
   104→	}
   105→}

   112→// buildCheckErrorMessage creates a user-facing error message tailored to the failure type.
   113→func buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType string, claudeCmd string, isCustom bool, stderrOutput string) string {
   114→	var errorMsg strings.Builder
   115→
   116→	switch errorType {
   117→	case "not_found":

   119→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   120→		errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Here's how to fix this:\n")
   121→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   122→		if isCustom {
   123→			errorMsg.WriteString("     The specified path doesn't exist. Please check:\n")
   124→			fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "     • Is Claude Code installed at %s?\n", claudeCmd)
   125→			errorMsg.WriteString("     • Did you type the path correctly?")
   126→		} else {
   127→			errorMsg.WriteString("     1. Make sure Claude Code is installed:\n")
   128→			errorMsg.WriteString("        • Visit https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/quickstart\n")
   129→			errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   130→			errorMsg.WriteString("     2. If it's already installed, try:\n")
   131→			errorMsg.WriteString("        • Check if 'claude' is in your PATH\n")
   132→			errorMsg.WriteString("        • Use -c flag to specify the full path\n")
   133→			errorMsg.WriteString("        • Example: specstory check claude -c \"~/.claude/local/claude\"")
   134→		}
   135→	case "permission_denied":
   136→		fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "  🔒 Permission denied when trying to run: %s\n", claudeCmd)
   137→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   138→		errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Here's how to fix this:\n")
   139→		fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "     • Check file permissions: chmod +x %s\n", claudeCmd)
   140→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Try running with elevated permissions if needed")
   141→	case "unexpected_output":
   142→		fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "  ⚠️  Unexpected output from 'claude -v': %s\n", strings.TrimSpace(stderrOutput))
   143→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   144→		errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 This might not be Claude Code. Expected output containing '(Claude Code)'.\n")
   145→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Make sure you have Claude Code installed, not a different 'claude' command\n")
   146→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Visit https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/quickstart for installation")
   147→	default:
   148→		errorMsg.WriteString("  ⚠️  Error running 'claude -v'\n")
   149→		if stderrOutput != "" {
   150→			fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "  📋 Error details: %s\n", stderrOutput)
   151→		}
   152→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   153→		errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Troubleshooting tips:\n")

   155→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Try running 'claude -v' directly in your terminal\n")
   156→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Check https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/quickstart for installation help")
   157→	}
   158→
   159→	return errorMsg.String()
   160→}
   161→
   162→// Check verifies Claude Code installation and returns version info
   163→func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
   164→	// Parse the command (no resume session for version check)
   165→	claudeCmd, _ := parseClaudeCommand(customCommand, "")
   166→
   167→	// Determine if custom command was used
   168→	isCustomCommand := customCommand != ""
   169→
   170→	// Resolve the actual path of the command
   171→	resolvedPath := claudeCmd
   172→	if !filepath.IsAbs(claudeCmd) {
   173→		// Try to find the command in PATH
   174→		if path, err := exec.LookPath(claudeCmd); err == nil {
   175→			resolvedPath = path
   176→		}
   177→	}
   178→
   179→	// Run claude -v to check version (ignore custom args for version check)
   180→	cmd := exec.Command(claudeCmd, "-v")
   181→	var out bytes.Buffer
   182→	var errOut bytes.Buffer
   183→	cmd.Stdout = &out
   184→	cmd.Stderr = &errOut
   185→
   186→	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
   187→		// Track installation check failure
   188→		errorType := "unknown"
   189→
   190→		var execErr *exec.Error
   191→		var pathErr *os.PathError
   192→
   193→		// Check error types in order of specificity
   194→		switch {
   195→		case errors.As(err, &execErr) && execErr.Err == exec.ErrNotFound:
   196→			errorType = "not_found"
   197→		case errors.As(err, &pathErr):
   198→			if errors.Is(pathErr.Err, os.ErrNotExist) {
   199→				errorType = "not_found"
   200→			} else if errors.Is(pathErr.Err, os.ErrPermission) {
   201→				errorType = "permission_denied"
   202→			}
   203→		case errors.Is(err, os.ErrPermission):
   204→			errorType = "permission_denied"
   205→		}
   206→
   207→		stderrOutput := strings.TrimSpace(errOut.String())
   208→		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
   209→			"provider":       "claude",
   210→			"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
   211→			"command_path":   claudeCmd,
   212→			"error_type":     errorType,
   213→			"error_message":  err.Error(),
   214→		})
   215→
   216→		errorMessage := buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, claudeCmd, isCustomCommand, stderrOutput)
   217→
   218→		return spi.CheckResult{
   219→			Success:      false,
   220→			Version:      "",
   221→			Location:     resolvedPath,
   222→			ErrorMessage: errorMessage,
   223→		}
   224→	}
   225→
   226→	// Check if output contains "Claude Code"
   227→	output := out.String()
   228→	if !strings.Contains(output, "(Claude Code)") {
   229→		// Track unexpected output error
   230→		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
   231→			"provider":       "claude",
   232→			"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
   233→			"command_path":   claudeCmd,
   234→			"error_type":     "unexpected_output",
   235→			"output":         strings.TrimSpace(output),
   236→		})
   237→
   238→		errorMessage := buildCheckErrorMessage("unexpected_output", claudeCmd, isCustomCommand, output)
   239→
   240→		return spi.CheckResult{
   241→			Success:      false,
   242→			Version:      "",
   243→			Location:     resolvedPath,
   244→			ErrorMessage: errorMessage,
   245→		}
   246→	}
   247→
   248→	// Success! Track it
   249→	analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallSuccess, analytics.Properties{
   250→		"provider":       "claude",
   251→		"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
   252→		"command_path":   resolvedPath,
   253→		"version":        strings.TrimSpace(output),
   254→	})
   255→
   256→	return spi.CheckResult{
   257→		Success:      true,
   258→		Version:      strings.TrimSpace(output),
   259→		Location:     resolvedPath,
   260→		ErrorMessage: "",
   261→	}
   262→}
   263→
   264→// DetectAgent checks if Claude Code has been used in the given project directory
   265→func (p *Provider) DetectAgent(projectPath string, helpOutput bool) bool {
   266→	// Get the Claude Code project directory for the given path
   267→	claudeProjectPath, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath)
   268→	if err != nil {
   269→		slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Failed to get Claude Code project directory", "error", err)
   270→		return false
   271→	}
   272→
   273→	// Check if the Claude Code project directory exists
   274→	if info, err := os.Stat(claudeProjectPath); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
   275→		slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Claude Code project found", "path", claudeProjectPath)
   276→		return true
   277→	}
   278→
   279→	slog.Debug("DetectAgent: No Claude Code project found", "expected_path", claudeProjectPath)
   280→
   281→	// If helpOutput is requested, provide helpful guidance
   282→	if helpOutput {
   283→		fmt.Println() // Add visual separation
   284→		log.UserWarn("No Claude Code project found for this directory.\n")
   285→		log.UserMessage("Claude Code hasn't created a project folder for your current directory yet.\n")
   286→		log.UserMessage("This happens when Claude Code hasn't been run in this directory.\n\n")
   287→		log.UserMessage("To fix this:\n")
   288→		log.UserMessage("  1. Run 'specstory run' to start Claude Code in this directory\n")
   289→		log.UserMessage("  2. Or run Claude Code directly with `claude`, then try syncing again\n\n")
   290→		log.UserMessage("Expected project folder: %s\n", claudeProjectPath)
   291→		fmt.Println() // Add trailing newline
   292→	}
   293→
   294→	return false
   295→}

   297→// GetAgentChatSessions retrieves all chat sessions for the given project path
   298→func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
   299→	// Get the Claude Code project directory
   300→	claudeProjectDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath)
   301→	if err != nil {
   302→		return nil, err
   303→	}
   304→
   305→	// Check if project directory exists
   306→	if _, err := os.Stat(claudeProjectDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
   307→		return []spi.AgentChatSession{}, nil // No sessions if no project
   308→	}
   309→
   310→	// Parse JSONL files with progress callback
   311→	parser := NewJSONLParser()
   312→	err = parser.ParseProjectSessionsWithProgress(claudeProjectDir, progress)
   313→	if err != nil {
   314→		return nil, err
   315→	}
   316→
   317→	// Convert sessions to AgentChatSession structs
   318→	result := make([]spi.AgentChatSession, 0, len(parser.Sessions))
   319→	for _, session := range parser.Sessions {
   320→		// Skip empty sessions (no records)
   321→		if len(session.Records) == 0 {
   322→			continue
   323→		}
   324→
   325→		// Process session (filter warmup, generate SessionData)
   326→		chatSession := processSession(session, projectPath, debugRaw)
   327→		if chatSession != nil {
   328→			result = append(result, *chatSession)
   329→		}
   330→	}
   331→
   332→	return result, nil
   333→}

   335→// GetAgentChatSession retrieves a single chat session by ID for the given project path
   336→func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSession(projectPath string, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
   337→	// Get the Claude Code project directory
   338→	claudeProjectDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath)
   339→	if err != nil {
   340→		return nil, err
   341→	}
   342→
   343→	// Check if project directory exists

   347→
   348→	// Parse only the session we're looking for

   350→	err = parser.ParseSingleSession(claudeProjectDir, sessionID)
   351→	if err != nil {

   353→		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not found") {

   359→	// Find the session

   365→
   366→	// Skip empty sessions (no records)
   367→	if len(session.Records) == 0 {
   368→		return nil, nil
   369→	}
   370→
   371→	// Process session (filter warmup, generate SessionData)

   375→// ExecAgentAndWatch executes Claude Code in interactive mode and watches for session updates
   376→func (p *Provider) ExecAgentAndWatch(projectPath string, customCommand string, resumeSessionID string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
   377→	slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: Starting Claude Code execution and monitoring",
   378→		"projectPath", projectPath,
   379→		"customCommand", customCommand,
   380→		"resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID,
   381→		"debugRaw", debugRaw)
   382→
   383→	// Validate resume session ID if provided (Claude Code uses UUID format)
   384→	if resumeSessionID != "" {
   385→		resumeSessionID = strings.TrimSpace(resumeSessionID)
   386→		// Simple UUID validation for Claude Code sessions
   387→		if len(resumeSessionID) != 36 || !strings.Contains(resumeSessionID, "-") {
   388→			return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID format for Claude Code: %s (must be a UUID)", resumeSessionID)
   389→		}
   390→		slog.Info("Resuming Claude Code session", "sessionId", resumeSessionID)
   391→	}
   392→
   393→	// Set up the callback which enables real-time markdown generation and cloud sync during
   394→	// interactive sessions. As Claude Code writes JSONL updates, the watcher detects
   395→	// changes and invokes this callback, allowing immediate processing without blocking
   396→	// the agent's execution. The defer ensures cleanup when the agent exits.
   397→	SetWatcherCallback(sessionCallback)
   398→	defer ClearWatcherCallback()
   399→
   400→	// Set debug raw mode for the watcher
   401→	SetWatcherDebugRaw(debugRaw)
   402→
   403→	// Start watching for project directory in the background
   404→	slog.Info("Initializing project directory monitoring...")
   405→
   406→	if err := WatchForProjectDir(); err != nil {
   407→		// Log the error but don't fail - watcher might work later
   408→		slog.Error("Failed to start project directory watcher", "error", err)
   409→	}
   410→
   411→	// Execute Claude Code - this blocks until Claude exits
   412→	slog.Info("Executing Claude Code", "command", customCommand)
   413→	err := ExecuteClaude(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
   414→
   415→	// Stop the watcher goroutine before returning
   416→	slog.Info("Claude Code has exited, stopping watcher")
   417→	StopWatcher()
   418→
   419→	// Return any execution error
   420→	if err != nil {
   421→		return fmt.Errorf("claude Code execution failed: %w", err)
   422→	}
   423→
   424→	return nil
   425→}
   426→
   427→// WatchAgent watches for Claude Code agent activity and calls the callback with AgentChatSession
   428→// Does NOT execute the agent - only watches for existing activity
   429→// Runs until error or context cancellation
   430→func (p *Provider) WatchAgent(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
   431→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Starting Claude Code activity monitoring",
   432→		"projectPath", projectPath,
   433→		"debugRaw", debugRaw)
   434→
   435→	// The watcher callback directly passes AgentChatSession (which now contains SessionData)
   436→	wrappedCallback := func(agentChatSession *spi.AgentChatSession) {
   437→		slog.Debug("WatchAgent: Received AgentChatSession",
   438→			"sessionID", agentChatSession.SessionID,
   439→			"hasSessionData", agentChatSession.SessionData != nil)
   440→
   441→		// Call the user's callback with the AgentChatSession
   442→		sessionCallback(agentChatSession)
   443→	}
   444→
   445→	// Set up the callback for the watcher
   446→	SetWatcherCallback(wrappedCallback)
   447→	defer ClearWatcherCallback()
   448→
   449→	// Set debug raw mode for the watcher
   450→	SetWatcherDebugRaw(debugRaw)
   451→
   452→	// Get the Claude Code project directory for the specified project path
   453→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Initializing project directory monitoring...")
   454→
   455→	claudeProjectDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath)
   456→	if err != nil {
   457→		slog.Error("WatchAgent: Failed to get Claude Code project directory", "error", err)
   458→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get project directory: %w", err)
   459→	}
   460→
   461→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Project directory found", "directory", claudeProjectDir)
   462→
   463→	if err := startProjectWatcher(claudeProjectDir); err != nil {
   464→		slog.Error("WatchAgent: Failed to start project watcher", "error", err)
   465→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start watcher: %w", err)
   466→	}
   467→
   468→	// Block until context is cancelled
   469→	// The watcher runs in a background goroutine and will continue
   470→	// until context is cancelled or the process exits
   471→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Watcher started, blocking until context cancelled")
   472→
   473→	// Wait for context cancellation
   474→	<-ctx.Done()
   475→
   476→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Context cancelled, stopping watcher")
   477→	StopWatcher()
   478→
   479→	return ctx.Err()
   480→}

   482→// findFirstUserMessage finds the first user message in a session for slug generation
   483→// Returns empty string if no suitable user message is found
   484→func findFirstUserMessage(session Session) string {
   485→	for _, record := range session.Records {
   486→		// Check if this is a user message
   487→		if recordType, ok := record.Data["type"].(string); !ok || recordType != "user" {
   488→			continue
   489→		}
   490→
   491→		// Skip meta user messages
   492→		if isMeta, ok := record.Data["isMeta"].(bool); ok && isMeta {
   493→			continue
   494→		}
   495→
   496→		// Extract content from message
   497→		if message, ok := record.Data["message"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   498→			if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok && content != "" {
   499→				// Skip messages containing "warmup" (case-insensitive)
   500→				if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(content), "warmup") {
   501→					continue
   502→				}
   503→				return content
   504→			}
   505→		}
   506→	}
   507→	return ""
   508→}
   509→
   510→// FileSlugFromRootRecord generates the slug part of the filename from the session
   511→// Returns the human-readable slug derived from the first user message, or empty string if none
   512→func FileSlugFromRootRecord(session Session) string {
   513→	// Find the first user message and generate slug from it
   514→	firstUserMessage := findFirstUserMessage(session)
   515→	slog.Debug("FileSlugFromRootRecord: First user message",
   516→		"sessionId", session.SessionUuid,
   517→		"message", firstUserMessage)
   518→
   519→	slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(firstUserMessage)
   520→	slog.Debug("FileSlugFromRootRecord: Generated slug",
   521→		"sessionId", session.SessionUuid,
   522→		"slug", slug)
   523→
   524→	return slug
   525→}

   527→// ListAgentChatSessions retrieves lightweight session metadata without full parsing
   528→// This is much faster than GetAgentChatSessions as it only reads minimal data from each session
   529→func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
   530→	// Get the Claude Code project directory
   531→	claudeProjectDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath)
   532→	if err != nil {
   533→		return nil, err
   534→	}
   535→
   536→	// Check if project directory exists
   537→	if _, err := os.Stat(claudeProjectDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
   538→		return []spi.SessionMetadata{}, nil // No sessions if no project
   539→	}
   540→
   541→	// Collect all JSONL files in the project directory
   542→	var sessionFiles []string
   543→	err = filepath.Walk(claudeProjectDir, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
   544→		if err != nil {
   545→			return err
   546→		}
   547→		if info.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(path, ".jsonl") {
   548→			return nil
   549→		}
   550→		sessionFiles = append(sessionFiles, path)
   551→		return nil
   552→	})
   553→	if err != nil {
   554→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to scan project directory: %w", err)
   555→	}
   556→
   557→	// Extract metadata from each session file
   558→	sessions := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(sessionFiles))
   559→	for _, filePath := range sessionFiles {
   560→		metadata, err := extractSessionMetadata(filePath)
   561→		if err != nil {
   562→			slog.Warn("Failed to extract session metadata",
   563→				"file", filePath,
   564→				"error", err)
   565→			continue
   566→		}
   567→
   568→		// Skip warmup-only sessions (no metadata means warmup-only)
   569→		if metadata == nil {
   570→			slog.Debug("Skipping warmup-only session", "file", filePath)
   571→			continue
   572→		}
   573→
   574→		sessions = append(sessions, *metadata)
   575→	}
   576→
   577→	return sessions, nil
   578→}
   579→
   580→// extractSessionMetadata reads minimal data from a session file to extract metadata
   581→// Returns nil if the session is warmup-only (no real messages)
   582→func extractSessionMetadata(filePath string) (*spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
   583→	file, err := os.Open(filePath)
   584→	if err != nil {
   585→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open session file: %w", err)
   586→	}
   587→	defer func() {
   588→		_ = file.Close()
   589→	}()
   590→
   591→	reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
   592→	var sessionID string
   593→	var timestamp string
   594→	var firstUserMessage string
   595→	foundRealMessage := false
   596→
   597→	// Read records until we find everything we need.
   598→	// Why: ReadString can return data AND io.EOF on the last line (no trailing newline),
   599→	// so we always process the line first, then check for EOF once at the bottom.
   600→	lineNum := 0
   601→	for {
   602→		line, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
   603→		if readErr != nil && readErr != io.EOF {
   604→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read line: %w", readErr)
   605→		}
   606→
   607→		lineNum++
   608→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   609→
   610→		if line != "" {
   611→			// Parse JSON record
   612→			var record map[string]interface{}
   613→			if jsonErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &record); jsonErr != nil {
   614→				slog.Warn("Skipping malformed JSONL line",
   615→					"file", filepath.Base(filePath),
   616→					"line", lineNum,
   617→					"error", jsonErr)
   618→			} else {
   619→				// Extract session ID (from any record)
   620→				if sessionID == "" {
   621→					if sid, ok := record["sessionId"].(string); ok {
   622→						sessionID = sid
   623→					}
   624→				}
   625→
   626→				// Only process non-sidechain, non-system records for message extraction
   627→				isSidechain, _ := record["isSidechain"].(bool)
   628→				recordType, hasType := record["type"].(string)
   629→				isSystemRecord := hasType && (recordType == "file-history-snapshot" || recordType == "file-change")
   630→
   631→				if !isSidechain && !isSystemRecord {
   632→					// This is the first real message record - extract timestamp
   633→					if !foundRealMessage {
   634→						foundRealMessage = true
   635→						if ts, ok := record["timestamp"].(string); ok {
   636→							timestamp = ts
   637→						}
   638→					}
   639→
   640→					// Extract first user message for slug (if this is a user message)
   641→					if firstUserMessage == "" && hasType && recordType == "user" {
   642→						isMeta, _ := record["isMeta"].(bool)
   643→						if !isMeta {
   644→							if message, ok := record["message"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   645→								if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok && content != "" {
   646→									// Skip messages containing "warmup"
   647→									if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(content), "warmup") {
   648→										firstUserMessage = content
   649→									}
   650→								}
   651→							}
   652→						}
   653→					}
   654→				}
   655→			}
   656→		}
   657→
   658→		// Single exit: found everything we need, or reached end of file
   659→		if (sessionID != "" && timestamp != "" && firstUserMessage != "") || readErr == io.EOF {
   660→			break
   661→		}
   662→	}
   663→
   664→	// If no real message was found, this is a warmup-only session
   665→	if !foundRealMessage {
   666→		return nil, nil
   667→	}
   668→
   669→	// Generate slug from first user message
   670→	slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(firstUserMessage)
   671→
   672→	// Generate human-readable name from first user message
   673→	name := spi.GenerateReadableName(firstUserMessage)
   674→
   675→	return &spi.SessionMetadata{
   676→		SessionID: sessionID,
   677→		CreatedAt: timestamp,
   678→		Slug:      slug,
   679→		Name:      name,
   680→	}, nil
   681→}

   103→// CloudSyncStats tracks the results of cloud sync operations
   104→type CloudSyncStats struct {
   105→	SessionsAttempted int32    // Total sessions that started sync attempt
   106→	SessionsSkipped   int32    // Already up to date on server
   107→	SessionsUpdated   int32    // Existed but needed update
   108→	SessionsCreated   int32    // New sessions created

   110→	SessionsTimedOut  int32    // Timed out waiting for overall sync completion (calculated at shutdown)

   114→// calculateTimedOut computes the number of sessions that timed out during sync.
   115→// This is calculated as: attempted - (skipped + updated + created + errored)
   116→// Includes defensive validation to prevent negative values in case of counter bugs.
   117→func (stats *CloudSyncStats) calculateTimedOut() {
   118→	finished := stats.SessionsSkipped + stats.SessionsUpdated + stats.SessionsCreated + stats.SessionsErrored
   119→
   120→	// Defensive validation: finished should never exceed attempted
   121→	if finished > stats.SessionsAttempted {
   122→		slog.Error("CloudSyncStats counter inconsistency detected",
   123→			"attempted", stats.SessionsAttempted,
   124→			"finished", finished,
   125→			"skipped", stats.SessionsSkipped,
   126→			"updated", stats.SessionsUpdated,
   127→			"created", stats.SessionsCreated,
   128→			"errored", stats.SessionsErrored)
   129→		stats.SessionsTimedOut = 0
   130→		return
   131→	}
   132→
   133→	stats.SessionsTimedOut = stats.SessionsAttempted - finished
   134→}

   166→// incrementCategory atomically increments the counter for a given category
   167→func (stats *CloudSyncStats) incrementCategory(category syncCategory) {
   168→	switch category {
   169→	case categorySkipped:
   170→		atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsSkipped, 1)
   171→	case categoryErrored:
   172→		atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsErrored, 1)
   173→	case categoryUpdated:
   174→		atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsUpdated, 1)
   175→	case categoryCreated:
   176→		atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsCreated, 1)
   177→	}
   178→}

   180→// decrementCategory atomically decrements the counter for a given category
   181→func (stats *CloudSyncStats) decrementCategory(category syncCategory) {
   182→	switch category {
   183→	case categorySkipped:
   184→		atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsSkipped, -1)
   185→	case categoryErrored:
   186→		atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsErrored, -1)
   187→	case categoryUpdated:
   188→		atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsUpdated, -1)
   189→	case categoryCreated:
   190→		atomic.AddInt32(&stats.SessionsCreated, -1)
   191→	}
   192→}
   193→
   194→// shouldReplaceCategory determines if newCategory should replace oldCategory based on precedence
   195→// Precedence (highest to lowest): created > updated > errored > skipped
   196→func shouldReplaceCategory(oldCategory, newCategory syncCategory) bool {
   197→	// Created never gets replaced
   198→	if oldCategory == categoryCreated {
   199→		return false
   200→	}
   201→	// Updated replaces skipped and errored
   202→	if newCategory == categoryUpdated {
   203→		return oldCategory == categorySkipped || oldCategory == categoryErrored
   204→	}
   205→	// Errored replaces only skipped
   206→	if newCategory == categoryErrored {
   207→		return oldCategory == categorySkipped
   208→	}
   209→	// Created replaces everything (but we already handled oldCategory == created above)
   210→	if newCategory == categoryCreated {
   211→		return true
   212→	}
   213→	// Skipped doesn't replace anything
   214→	return false
   215→}
   216→
   217→// trackSessionInCategory records a session in a category and updates counters atomically
   218→// Handles precedence rules and automatically increments/decrements appropriate counters
   219→func (stats *CloudSyncStats) trackSessionInCategory(sessionID string, newCategory syncCategory) {
   220→	for {
   221→		// Try to load existing category
   222→		existing, loaded := stats.countedSessions.Load(sessionID)
   223→
   224→		if !loaded {
   225→			// No existing entry, try to store
   226→			actual, loaded := stats.countedSessions.LoadOrStore(sessionID, newCategory)
   227→			if !loaded {
   228→				// Successfully stored new category - increment counter
   229→				stats.incrementCategory(newCategory)
   230→				return
   231→			}
   232→			// Someone else stored it first, loop to check precedence
   233→			existing = actual
   234→		}
   235→
   236→		oldCategory := existing.(syncCategory)
   237→
   238→		// Check if we should replace the old category
   239→		if !shouldReplaceCategory(oldCategory, newCategory) {
   240→			// Don't replace - higher precedence category already exists
   241→			return
   242→		}
   243→
   244→		// Try to replace old category with new category
   245→		if stats.countedSessions.CompareAndSwap(sessionID, oldCategory, newCategory) {
   246→			// Successfully replaced - decrement old counter and increment new counter
   247→			stats.decrementCategory(oldCategory)
   248→			stats.incrementCategory(newCategory)
   249→			return
   250→		}
   251→		// CompareAndSwap failed, someone else modified it, loop again
   252→	}
   253→}
   254→
   255→// acquireHTTPSemaphore acquires the HTTP semaphore (blocks until available)
   256→// Returns a release function that should be called with defer
   257→//
   258→// No timeout - blocks indefinitely until semaphore is available. Goroutines that don't acquire
   259→// before the overall sync timeout (CloudSyncTimeout) are orphaned, but this is acceptable because
   260→// the process terminates after sync timeout. The overall timeout handles cleanup and stats reporting.
   261→func (syncMgr *SyncManager) acquireHTTPSemaphore(sessionID, requestType string) (releaseFunc func()) {
   262→	// Block until semaphore slot is available
   263→	syncMgr.httpSemaphore <- struct{}{}
   264→
   265→	slog.Debug("Acquired HTTP semaphore",
   266→		"sessionId", sessionID,
   267→		"requestType", requestType,
   268→		"currentConcurrency", len(syncMgr.httpSemaphore))
   269→
   270→	releaseFunc = func() {
   271→		<-syncMgr.httpSemaphore
   272→		slog.Debug("Released HTTP semaphore",
   273→			"sessionId", sessionID,
   274→			"requestType", requestType,
   275→			"currentConcurrency", len(syncMgr.httpSemaphore))
   276→	}
   277→	return releaseFunc
   278→}
   279→
   280→// fetchBulkSessionSizes fetches markdown sizes for all sessions in a project from the SpecStory Cloud API.
   281→// This enables batch sync optimization by avoiding individual HEAD requests for each session.
   282→//
   283→// The function makes a GET request to /api/v1/projects/{projectID}/sessions/sizes with automatic
   284→// retry logic (3 attempts with 1 second delay between retries) to handle transient network failures.
   285→// This function is only called once during batch sync initialization, so no HTTP semaphore is needed.
   286→//
   287→// Parameters:
   288→//   - projectID: The project identifier (git_id, workspace_id, or directory name)
   289→//
   290→// Returns:
   291→//   - map[string]int: Map of sessionID to markdown content size in bytes. Empty map if project has no sessions.
   292→//   - error: Non-nil if all retry attempts fail, including request creation, network, parsing, or API errors.
   293→//
   294→// The function logs at Debug level for normal operation and Error level for failures. On success, it logs
   295→// at Info level with the count of sessions fetched.
   296→func (syncMgr *SyncManager) fetchBulkSessionSizes(projectID string) (map[string]int, error) {
   297→	const maxAttempts = 3
   298→	const retryDelay = 1 * time.Second
   299→
   300→	apiURL := GetAPIBaseURL() + "/api/v1/projects/" + projectID + "/sessions/sizes"
   301→
   302→	for attempt := 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++ {
   303→		// Log attempt
   304→		if attempt == 1 {
   305→			slog.Debug("Fetching bulk session sizes",
   306→				"projectId", projectID,
   307→				"url", apiURL,
   308→				"attempt", attempt)
   309→		} else {
   310→			slog.Debug("Retrying bulk session sizes fetch",
   311→				"projectId", projectID,
   312→				"url", apiURL,
   313→				"attempt", attempt)
   314→		}
   315→
   316→		// Make GET request
   317→		req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", apiURL, nil)
   318→		if err != nil {
   319→			slog.Error("Failed to create GET request for bulk sizes",
   320→				"projectId", projectID,
   321→				"attempt", attempt,
   322→				"error", err)
   323→			if attempt < maxAttempts {
   324→				time.Sleep(retryDelay)
   325→				continue
   326→			}
   327→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request after %d attempts: %w", maxAttempts, err)
   328→		}
   329→
   330→		// Add auth headers
   331→		cloudToken := GetCloudToken()
   332→		req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+cloudToken)
   333→		req.Header.Set("User-Agent", GetUserAgent())
   334→
   335→		// Create HTTP client with timeout
   336→		client := &http.Client{
   337→			Timeout: 30 * time.Second,
   338→		}
   339→
   340→		// Execute request
   341→		resp, err := client.Do(req)
   342→
   343→		if err != nil {
   344→			slog.Debug("Bulk sizes GET request failed",
   345→				"projectId", projectID,
   346→				"attempt", attempt,
   347→				"error", err)
   348→			if attempt < maxAttempts {
   349→				time.Sleep(retryDelay)
   350→				continue
   351→			}
   352→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("GET request failed after %d attempts: %w", maxAttempts, err)
   353→		}
   354→
   355→		// Read response body
   356→		defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()
   357→		respBody, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
   358→		if err != nil {
   359→			slog.Error("Failed to read bulk sizes response body",
   360→				"projectId", projectID,
   361→				"attempt", attempt,
   362→				"status", resp.StatusCode,
   363→				"error", err)
   364→			if attempt < maxAttempts {
   365→				time.Sleep(retryDelay)
   366→				continue
   367→			}
   368→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body after %d attempts: %w", maxAttempts, err)
   369→		}
   370→
   371→		// Check status code
   372→		if resp.StatusCode != 200 {
   373→			slog.Debug("Bulk sizes GET returned non-200 status",
   374→				"projectId", projectID,
   375→				"attempt", attempt,
   376→				"status", resp.StatusCode,
   377→				"responseBody", string(respBody))
   378→			if attempt < maxAttempts {
   379→				time.Sleep(retryDelay)
   380→				continue
   381→			}
   382→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("GET request returned status %d after %d attempts", resp.StatusCode, maxAttempts)
   383→		}
   384→
   385→		// Parse JSON response
   386→		var bulkResponse BulkSizesResponse
   387→		err = json.Unmarshal(respBody, &bulkResponse)
   388→		if err != nil {
   389→			slog.Error("Failed to parse bulk sizes JSON response",
   390→				"projectId", projectID,
   391→				"attempt", attempt,
   392→				"error", err,
   393→				"responseBody", string(respBody))
   394→			if attempt < maxAttempts {
   395→				time.Sleep(retryDelay)
   396→				continue
   397→			}
   398→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse JSON after %d attempts: %w", maxAttempts, err)
   399→		}
   400→
   401→		// Check success field
   402→		if !bulkResponse.Success {
   403→			slog.Warn("Bulk sizes response indicated failure",
   404→				"projectId", projectID,
   405→				"attempt", attempt)
   406→			if attempt < maxAttempts {
   407→				time.Sleep(retryDelay)
   408→				continue
   409→			}
   410→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("API returned success=false after %d attempts", maxAttempts)
   411→		}
   412→
   413→		// Success - log and return
   414→		sessionCount := len(bulkResponse.Data.Sessions)
   415→		slog.Info("Fetched bulk session sizes",
   416→			"projectId", projectID,
   417→			"sessionCount", sessionCount)
   418→		return bulkResponse.Data.Sessions, nil
   419→	}
   420→
   421→	// Should never reach here, but just in case
   422→	return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to fetch bulk sizes after %d attempts", maxAttempts)
   423→}
   424→
   425→// PreloadSessionSizes fetches and caches session sizes for all sessions in a project
   426→// This is a blocking call that should be made before syncing multiple sessions
   427→// If fetch fails, logs warning and leaves cache nil (enables HEAD request fallback)
   428→func (syncMgr *SyncManager) PreloadSessionSizes(projectID string) {
   429→	if syncMgr == nil {
   430→		slog.Warn("PreloadSessionSizes called with nil sync manager")
   431→		return
   432→	}
   433→
   434→	slog.Debug("Preloading session sizes for batch sync",
   435→		"projectId", projectID)
   436→
   437→	// Fetch bulk sizes (with retry logic)
   438→	sizes, err := syncMgr.fetchBulkSessionSizes(projectID)
   439→	if err != nil {
   440→		// Log error and leave cache nil to trigger HEAD request fallback
   441→		slog.Error("Failed to fetch bulk session sizes, will fall back to HEAD requests",
   442→			"projectId", projectID,
   443→			"error", err)
   444→		return
   445→	}
   446→
   447→	// Store in cache with write lock
   448→	syncMgr.bulkSizesMu.Lock()
   449→	defer syncMgr.bulkSizesMu.Unlock()
   450→	syncMgr.bulkSizes = sizes
   451→
   452→	sessionCount := len(sizes)
   453→	slog.Info("Preloaded session sizes from server",
   454→		"projectId", projectID,
   455→		"sessionCount", sessionCount)
   456→}
   457→
   458→// requiresSync checks if a session needs to be synced to the cloud
   459→// Returns true if sync is needed, false if already up-to-date
   460→func (syncMgr *SyncManager) requiresSync(sessionID, mdPath, mdContent, projectID string, skipHeadCheck bool) (bool, error) {
   461→	// Skip HEAD check if requested (caller determined sync is needed)
   462→	if skipHeadCheck {
   463→		slog.Debug("Skipping HEAD check (skipHeadCheck=true)",
   464→			"sessionId", sessionID)
   465→		return true, nil
   466→	}
   467→
   468→	// Get size from passed content
   469→	localSize := len(mdContent)
   470→
   471→	// Check if bulk sizes are preloaded (batch sync mode)
   472→	syncMgr.bulkSizesMu.RLock()
   473→	bulkSizes := syncMgr.bulkSizes
   474→	syncMgr.bulkSizesMu.RUnlock()
   475→
   476→	if bulkSizes != nil {
   477→		// Bulk sizes are available - use cached data instead of HEAD request
   478→		serverSize, exists := bulkSizes[sessionID]
   479→		if !exists {
   480→			// Session not in bulk sizes map - doesn't exist on server yet
   481→			slog.Debug("Using preloaded size for sync check: session not on server",
   482→				"sessionId", sessionID,
   483→				"localSize", localSize)
   484→			return true, nil
   485→		}
   486→
   487→		// Compare sizes
   488→		needsSync := localSize > serverSize
   489→		if needsSync {
   490→			slog.Debug("Using preloaded size for sync check: local is larger",
   491→				"sessionId", sessionID,
   492→				"localSize", localSize,
   493→				"serverSize", serverSize)
   494→		} else {
   495→			slog.Info("Session already up-to-date on server (using preloaded sizes), skipping sync",
   496→				"sessionId", sessionID,
   497→				"localSize", localSize,
   498→				"serverSize", serverSize)
   499→		}
   500→		return needsSync, nil
   501→	}
   502→
   503→	// Bulk sizes not available - fall back to HEAD request
   504→	slog.Debug("Using HEAD request for sync check (no bulk sizes)",
   505→		"sessionId", sessionID)
   506→
   507→	// Acquire semaphore for HEAD request (blocks until available)
   508→	release := syncMgr.acquireHTTPSemaphore(sessionID, "HEAD")
   509→	defer release()
   510→
   511→	// Make HEAD request
   512→	apiURL := GetAPIBaseURL() + "/api/v1/projects/" + projectID + "/sessions/" + sessionID
   513→	req, err := http.NewRequest("HEAD", apiURL, nil)
   514→	if err != nil {
   515→		slog.Error("Failed to create HEAD request",
   516→			"sessionId", sessionID,
   517→			"error", err)
   518→		return false, err
   519→	}
   520→
   521→	// Add auth headers
   522→	cloudToken := GetCloudToken()
   523→	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+cloudToken)
   524→	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", GetUserAgent())
   525→
   526→	// Create HTTP client with shorter timeout for HEAD
   527→	client := &http.Client{
   528→		Timeout: 10 * time.Second,
   529→	}
   530→
   531→	slog.Debug("Cloud sync HEAD request",
   532→		"sessionId", sessionID,
   533→		"url", apiURL,
   534→		"localMarkdownSize", localSize)
   535→
   536→	// Execute request
   537→	resp, err := client.Do(req)
   538→	if err != nil {
   539→		slog.Debug("HEAD request failed, will attempt sync",
   540→			"sessionId", sessionID,
   541→			"error", err)
   542→		return true, nil // Err on side of syncing if HEAD fails
   543→	}
   544→	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()
   545→
   546→	slog.Debug("Cloud sync HEAD response",
   547→		"sessionId", sessionID,
   548→		"status", resp.StatusCode,
   549→		"headers", resp.Header)
   550→
   551→	// Check response
   552→	if resp.StatusCode == 404 {
   553→		slog.Debug("Session not found on server, will sync",
   554→			"sessionId", sessionID)
   555→		return true, nil
   556→	}
   557→
   558→	if resp.StatusCode == 200 {
   559→		serverSizeStr := resp.Header.Get("X-Markdown-Size")
   560→		if serverSizeStr == "" {
   561→			slog.Debug("No X-Markdown-Size header, will sync",
   562→				"sessionId", sessionID)
   563→			return true, nil
   564→		}
   565→
   566→		serverSize, err := strconv.Atoi(serverSizeStr)
   567→		if err != nil {
   568→			slog.Debug("Invalid X-Markdown-Size header, will sync",
   569→				"sessionId", sessionID,
   570→				"headerValue", serverSizeStr,
   571→				"error", err)
   572→			return true, nil
   573→		}
   574→
   575→		if localSize > serverSize {
   576→			slog.Debug("Local markdown larger than server, will sync",
   577→				"sessionId", sessionID,
   578→				"localSize", localSize,
   579→				"serverSize", serverSize)
   580→			return true, nil
   581→		}
   582→
   583→		slog.Info("Session already up-to-date on server, skipping sync",
   584→			"sessionId", sessionID,
   585→			"localSize", localSize,
   586→			"serverSize", serverSize)
   587→		return false, nil
   588→	}
   589→
   590→	// For any other status codes, err on side of syncing
   591→	slog.Debug("Unexpected HEAD response status, will sync",
   592→		"sessionId", sessionID,
   593→		"status", resp.StatusCode)
   594→	return true, nil
   595→}

   625→// getDeviceID generates a unique device ID based on MAC address
   626→func getDeviceID() string {
   627→	// Return cached value if available
   628→	if deviceID != "" {
   629→		return deviceID
   630→	}
   631→
   632→	// Get all network interfaces
   633→	interfaces, err := net.Interfaces()
   634→	if err != nil {
   635→		slog.Warn("Failed to get network interfaces", "error", err)
   636→		// Fallback to hostname-based ID
   637→		hostname, _ := os.Hostname()
   638→		h := sha256.Sum256([]byte("specstory-" + hostname))
   639→		deviceID = hex.EncodeToString(h[:])
   640→		return deviceID
   641→	}
   642→
   643→	// Find the first non-loopback interface with a MAC address
   644→	for _, iface := range interfaces {
   645→		if iface.Flags&net.FlagLoopback == 0 && len(iface.HardwareAddr) > 0 {
   646→			// Hash the MAC address
   647→			h := sha256.Sum256(iface.HardwareAddr)
   648→			deviceID = hex.EncodeToString(h[:])
   649→			slog.Debug("Generated device ID from interface", "interface", iface.Name)
   650→			return deviceID
   651→		}
   652→	}
   653→
   654→	// Fallback if no suitable interface found
   655→	hostname, _ := os.Hostname()
   656→	h := sha256.Sum256([]byte("specstory-fallback-" + hostname))
   657→	deviceID = hex.EncodeToString(h[:])
   658→	slog.Debug("Using fallback device ID based on hostname")
   659→	return deviceID
   660→}

   691→// performSync executes the actual sync operation (HEAD check + PUT request)
   692→func (syncMgr *SyncManager) performSync(sessionID, mdPath, mdContent string, rawData []byte, agentName string, skipHeadCheck bool) {
   693→	timestamp := time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
   694→
   695→	// Log the sync attempt
   696→	slog.Info("Cloud sync initiated",
   697→		"sessionId", sessionID,
   698→		"mdPath", mdPath,
   699→		"agentName", agentName,
   700→		"timestamp", timestamp)
   701→
   702→	// Track that this session attempted to sync (for timeout calculation at shutdown)
   703→	// Only count each unique session once, even if performSync is called multiple times
   704→	// (e.g., due to debouncing in run mode triggering multiple syncs for the same session)
   705→	// Note: We check the map here but don't store yet - trackSessionInCategory() (called
   706→	// later in this function on every code path) will store the session in the map
   707→	if _, alreadyTracked := syncMgr.stats.countedSessions.Load(sessionID); !alreadyTracked {
   708→		atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.stats.SessionsAttempted, 1)
   709→	}
   710→
   711→	// Content is now passed in as parameters, no need to read files
   712→
   713→	// Create sync session data
   714→	syncData := SyncSession{
   715→		SessionID:    sessionID,
   716→		MDPath:       mdPath,
   717→		JSONLPath:    "", // No longer using file path
   718→		JSONLContent: rawData,
   719→		MDContent:    mdContent,
   720→	}
   721→
   722→	// Read project configuration
   723→	projectData, err := readProjectConfig()
   724→	if err != nil {
   725→		slog.Warn("Cannot sync session to cloud: failed to read project config", "error", err, "sessionId", sessionID)
   726→		syncMgr.stats.trackSessionInCategory(sessionID, categoryErrored)
   727→		return
   728→	}
   729→
   730→	// Determine project ID - use git_id if present, otherwise workspace_id
   731→	projectID := ""
   732→	if projectData != nil && projectData.GitID != "" {
   733→		projectID = projectData.GitID
   734→	} else if projectData != nil && projectData.WorkspaceID != "" {
   735→		projectID = projectData.WorkspaceID
   736→	}
   737→
   738→	// Project ID is required for cloud sync
   739→	if projectID == "" {
   740→		slog.Warn("Cannot sync session to cloud: no project ID available", "sessionId", sessionID)
   741→		syncMgr.stats.trackSessionInCategory(sessionID, categoryErrored)
   742→		return
   743→	}
   744→
   745→	// Get project name (use directory name as fallback - this is cosmetic only)
   746→	projectName := ""
   747→	if projectData != nil && projectData.ProjectName != "" {
   748→		projectName = projectData.ProjectName
   749→	} else {
   750→		// Fallback to extracting from mdPath for display purposes only
   751→		dir := filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(mdPath))      // Go up from history to .specstory
   752→		projectName = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(dir)) // Get the project directory name
   753→		slog.Debug("No project name in config, using directory name", "projectName", projectName)
   754→	}
   755→
   756→	// Check if sync is needed using HEAD request
   757→	shouldSync, err := syncMgr.requiresSync(sessionID, mdPath, mdContent, projectID, skipHeadCheck)

   880→// debouncedSync implements debouncing logic for a session
   881→// Always skips HEAD check since we know content just changed in autosave mode
   882→func (syncMgr *SyncManager) debouncedSync(sessionID, mdPath, mdContent string, rawData []byte, agentName string) {
   883→	// Get or create debounce state for this session
   884→	stateInterface, _ := syncMgr.debounceSessions.LoadOrStore(sessionID, &sessionDebounceState{})
   885→	state := stateInterface.(*sessionDebounceState)
   886→
   887→	state.mu.Lock()
   888→	defer state.mu.Unlock()
   889→
   890→	now := time.Now()
   891→	timeSinceLastSync := now.Sub(state.lastSyncTime)
   892→
   893→	// Check if we can sync immediately (no recent sync or first sync)
   894→	if state.lastSyncTime.IsZero() || timeSinceLastSync >= syncMgr.debounceInterval {
   895→		// Sync immediately
   896→		state.lastSyncTime = now
   897→		state.pending = nil
   898→
   899→		// Cancel any pending timer
   900→		if state.timer != nil {
   901→			state.timer.Stop()
   902→			state.timer = nil
   903→		}
   904→
   905→		// Start sync in goroutine (always skip HEAD check in autosave mode)
   906→		syncMgr.wg.Add(1)
   907→		atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.syncCount, 1)
   908→		go func() {
   909→			defer func() {
   910→				syncMgr.wg.Done()
   911→				atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.syncCount, -1)
   912→			}()
   913→			syncMgr.performSync(sessionID, mdPath, mdContent, rawData, agentName, true)
   914→		}()
   915→
   916→		// Log with timeSinceLastSync only if meaningful (not after cleanup)
   917→		if state.lastSyncTime.IsZero() {
   918→			slog.Debug("Cloud sync started immediately",
   919→				"sessionId", sessionID)
   920→		} else {
   921→			slog.Debug("Cloud sync started immediately",
   922→				"sessionId", sessionID,
   923→				"timeSinceLastSync", timeSinceLastSync)
   924→		}
   925→		return
   926→	}
   927→
   928→	// Within debounce window - queue or replace pending request
   929→	state.pending = &pendingSyncRequest{
   930→		sessionID: sessionID,
   931→		mdPath:    mdPath,
   932→		mdContent: mdContent,
   933→		rawData:   rawData,
   934→		agentName: agentName,
   935→	}
   936→
   937→	// Set timer if not already set
   938→	if state.timer == nil {
   939→		timeUntilSync := syncMgr.debounceInterval - timeSinceLastSync
   940→		state.timer = time.AfterFunc(timeUntilSync, func() {
   941→			syncMgr.flushPendingSync(sessionID)
   942→		})
   943→
   944→		slog.Debug("Cloud sync queued with new timer",
   945→			"sessionId", sessionID,
   946→			"timeUntilSync", timeUntilSync)
   947→	} else {
   948→		slog.Debug("Cloud sync queued (replaced pending)",
   949→			"sessionId", sessionID)
   950→	}
   951→}
   952→
   953→// flushPendingSync is called by timer to flush a queued sync
   954→func (syncMgr *SyncManager) flushPendingSync(sessionID string) {
   955→	stateInterface, ok := syncMgr.debounceSessions.Load(sessionID)
   956→	if !ok {
   957→		return
   958→	}
   959→	state := stateInterface.(*sessionDebounceState)
   960→
   961→	state.mu.Lock()
   962→	defer state.mu.Unlock()
   963→
   964→	// Sync the pending request (timer is only set when pending is non-nil)
   965→	req := state.pending
   966→	state.pending = nil
   967→	state.timer = nil
   968→
   969→	// Guard against nil pending request (defensive programming)
   970→	if req == nil {
   971→		slog.Warn("Timer fired but no pending request found",
   972→			"sessionId", sessionID)
   973→		syncMgr.debounceSessions.Delete(sessionID)
   974→		return
   975→	}
   976→
   977→	// Clean up the session state from the map since we're done with this debounce cycle
   978→	// If another event comes later, LoadOrStore will create a fresh state
   979→	syncMgr.debounceSessions.Delete(sessionID)
   980→
   981→	// Start sync in goroutine (always skip HEAD check for debounced syncs)
   982→	syncMgr.wg.Add(1)
   983→	atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.syncCount, 1)
   984→	go func() {
   985→		defer func() {
   986→			syncMgr.wg.Done()
   987→			atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.syncCount, -1)
   988→		}()
   989→		syncMgr.performSync(req.sessionID, req.mdPath, req.mdContent, req.rawData, req.agentName, true)
   990→	}()
   991→
   992→	slog.Debug("Flushed pending sync after debounce, cleaned up session state",
   993→		"sessionId", sessionID)
   994→}
   995→
   996→// flushAllPending flushes all pending debounced syncs (called on shutdown)
   997→func (syncMgr *SyncManager) flushAllPending() {
   998→	slog.Debug("Flushing all pending debounced syncs")
   999→
  1000→	syncMgr.debounceSessions.Range(func(key, value interface{}) bool {
  1001→		sessionID := key.(string)
  1002→		state := value.(*sessionDebounceState)
  1003→
  1004→		state.mu.Lock()
  1005→		defer state.mu.Unlock()
  1006→
  1007→		// Cancel timer
  1008→		if state.timer != nil {
  1009→			state.timer.Stop()
  1010→			state.timer = nil
  1011→		}
  1012→
  1013→		// If there's a pending request, sync it immediately
  1014→		if state.pending != nil {
  1015→			req := state.pending
  1016→			state.pending = nil
  1017→
  1018→			// Start sync in goroutine (always skip HEAD check for debounced syncs)
  1019→			syncMgr.wg.Add(1)

  1021→			go func() {
  1022→				defer func() {
  1023→					syncMgr.wg.Done()
  1024→					atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.syncCount, -1)

  1026→				syncMgr.performSync(req.sessionID, req.mdPath, req.mdContent, req.rawData, req.agentName, true)
  1027→			}()

  1029→			slog.Info("Flushing pending sync on shutdown",

  1037→// SyncSessionToCloud asynchronously syncs a session to the cloud
  1038→// When isAutosaveMode is true (run command), syncs are debounced and skip HEAD checks for efficiency
  1039→// When isAutosaveMode is false (manual sync), syncs are immediate with HEAD checks
  1040→func SyncSessionToCloud(sessionID string, mdPath string, mdContent string, rawData []byte, agentName string, isAutosaveMode bool) {
  1041→	syncManagerMutex.RLock()
  1042→	syncMgr := globalSyncManager
  1043→	syncManagerMutex.RUnlock()
  1044→
  1045→	if syncMgr == nil || !syncMgr.enabled {
  1046→		if syncMgr == nil {
  1047→			slog.Warn("Cloud sync not initialized, skipping sync", "sessionId", sessionID)
  1048→		} else {
  1049→			slog.Debug("Cloud sync disabled by flag, skipping sync", "sessionId", sessionID)
  1050→		}
  1051→		return
  1052→	}
  1053→
  1054→	// Check authentication
  1055→	if !IsAuthenticated() {
  1056→		slog.Warn("Cloud sync skipped: user not authenticated", "sessionId", sessionID)
  1057→		return
  1058→	}
  1059→
  1060→	// Route to debounced or immediate sync based on mode
  1061→	if isAutosaveMode {
  1062→		// Autosave mode: debounce syncs and skip HEAD checks
  1063→		syncMgr.debouncedSync(sessionID, mdPath, mdContent, rawData, agentName)
  1064→	} else {
  1065→		// Manual sync mode: immediate sync with HEAD check
  1066→		syncMgr.wg.Add(1)
  1067→		atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.syncCount, 1)
  1068→		go func() {
  1069→			defer func() {
  1070→				syncMgr.wg.Done()
  1071→				atomic.AddInt32(&syncMgr.syncCount, -1)
  1072→			}()
  1073→			syncMgr.performSync(sessionID, mdPath, mdContent, rawData, agentName, false)
  1074→		}()
  1075→	}
  1076→}

  1078→// getStats loads atomic counters and returns a CloudSyncStats with calculated timeout count.
  1079→// This consolidates the pattern of loading counters + calculating timeouts used in multiple shutdown paths.
  1080→func (sm *SyncManager) getStats() *CloudSyncStats {
  1081→	stats := &CloudSyncStats{
  1082→		SessionsAttempted: atomic.LoadInt32(&sm.stats.SessionsAttempted),
  1083→		SessionsSkipped:   atomic.LoadInt32(&sm.stats.SessionsSkipped),
  1084→		SessionsUpdated:   atomic.LoadInt32(&sm.stats.SessionsUpdated),
  1085→		SessionsCreated:   atomic.LoadInt32(&sm.stats.SessionsCreated),
  1086→		SessionsErrored:   atomic.LoadInt32(&sm.stats.SessionsErrored),
  1087→	}
  1088→	stats.calculateTimedOut()
  1089→	return stats
  1090→}
  1091→
  1092→// Shutdown waits for all cloud sync operations to complete with a timeout and returns statistics
  1093→func Shutdown(timeout time.Duration) *CloudSyncStats {
  1094→	syncManagerMutex.RLock()
  1095→	sm := globalSyncManager
  1096→	syncManagerMutex.RUnlock()
  1097→
  1098→	if sm == nil || !sm.enabled {
  1099→		return nil
  1100→	}
  1101→
  1102→	// Flush all pending debounced syncs before waiting
  1103→	sm.flushAllPending()
  1104→
  1105→	// Create a channel to signal when all syncs are done
  1106→	done := make(chan struct{})
  1107→	go func() {
  1108→		sm.wg.Wait()
  1109→		close(done)
  1110→	}()
  1111→
  1112→	// Give goroutines a moment to start and check if we have any work
  1113→	time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
  1114→
  1115→	// Check if all work is already done (e.g., all sessions were skipped)
  1116→	select {
  1117→	case <-done:
  1118→		// All work completed very quickly (likely all skipped)
  1119→		stats := sm.getStats()
  1120→		// If we have stats, return them
  1121→		if stats.SessionsAttempted > 0 {
  1122→			return stats
  1123→		}
  1124→		// No work was done at all
  1125→		return nil
  1126→	default:
  1127→		// Work is still in progress, continue to show countdown
  1128→	}
  1129→
  1130→	// Create a ticker for countdown updates
  1131→	ticker := time.NewTicker(1 * time.Second)
  1132→	defer ticker.Stop()
  1133→
  1134→	// Track elapsed time
  1135→	start := time.Now()
  1136→
  1137→	// Show initial countdown immediately
  1138→	if !sm.silent {
  1139→		fmt.Printf("Waiting for cloud sync to complete... %ds until timeout", int(timeout.Seconds()))
  1140→	}
  1141→
  1142→	for {
  1143→		select {
  1144→		case <-done:
  1145→			// Ensure countdown is visible for at least 1 second
  1146→			elapsed := time.Since(start)
  1147→			if elapsed < 1*time.Second {
  1148→				time.Sleep(1*time.Second - elapsed)
  1149→			}
  1150→
  1151→			// All syncs completed - clear the progress line
  1152→			if !sm.silent {
  1153→				// Clear the line by printing spaces over it, then return to beginning
  1154→				fmt.Printf("\r%60s\r", "")
  1155→			}
  1156→
  1157→			// Return stats
  1158→			return sm.getStats()
  1159→		case <-ticker.C:
  1160→			// Update countdown
  1161→			elapsed := time.Since(start)
  1162→			remaining := timeout - elapsed
  1163→			if remaining <= 0 {
  1164→				// Timeout reached - clear the progress line
  1165→				if !sm.silent {
  1166→					fmt.Printf("\r%60s\r", "")
  1167→					fmt.Printf("Cloud sync timeout. Some syncs may not have completed.\n")
  1168→				}
  1169→				slog.Warn("Cloud sync shutdown timeout", "timeout", timeout)
  1170→
  1171→				// Return partial stats
  1172→				return sm.getStats()
  1173→			}
  1174→			// Show countdown
  1175→			if !sm.silent {
  1176→				fmt.Printf("\rWaiting for cloud sync to complete... %ds until timeout", int(remaining.Seconds()))
  1177→			}
  1178→		}
  1179→	}
  1180→}
