    93→// parseResourceAttributes parses OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES env var into attribute.KeyValue slice.
    94→// Format: "key1=value1,key2=value2"
    95→func parseResourceAttributes() []attribute.KeyValue {
    96→	envVal := os.Getenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES")
    97→	if envVal == "" {
    98→		return nil
    99→	}
   100→
   101→	var attrs []attribute.KeyValue
   102→	pairs := strings.Split(envVal, ",")
   103→	for _, pair := range pairs {
   104→		pair = strings.TrimSpace(pair)
   105→		if pair == "" {
   106→			continue
   107→		}
   108→		kv := strings.SplitN(pair, "=", 2)
   109→		if len(kv) == 2 {
   110→			key := strings.TrimSpace(kv[0])
   111→			value := strings.TrimSpace(kv[1])
   112→			if key != "" {
   113→				attrs = append(attrs, attribute.String(key, value))
   114→			}
   115→		}
   116→	}
   117→	return attrs
   118→}
   119→
   120→// parseEndpoint normalises an OTLP endpoint string into a bare host:port suitable
   121→// for otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint and a flag indicating whether TLS should be disabled.
   122→//
   123→// Accepted formats:
   124→//
   125→//	"localhost:4317"                 → host="localhost:4317",          insecure=true
   126→//	"http://localhost:4317"          → host="localhost:4317",          insecure=true
   127→//	"https://collector.example:4317" → host="collector.example:4317",  insecure=false
   128→func parseEndpoint(raw string) (host string, insecure bool) {
   129→	u, err := url.Parse(raw)
   130→	if err != nil || u.Host == "" {
   131→		// Not a URL — treat the whole string as host:port (bare address).
   132→		return raw, true
   133→	}
   134→
   135→	// Parsed successfully as a URL with a scheme.
   136→	host = u.Host
   137→	insecure = u.Scheme != "https"
   138→	return host, insecure
   139→}
   140→
   141→// Init configures the OTel tracing and metrics subsystem. Thread-safe and idempotent — only the
   142→// first call takes effect. When Enabled is false the global no-op provider remains
   143→// active, so callers can emit spans/events and record metrics safely with zero overhead.
   144→func Init(ctx context.Context, opts Options) error {
   145→	var initErr error
   146→	initOnce.Do(func() {
   147→		if !opts.Enabled {
   148→			telemetryLogger().Info("Telemetry disabled, using no-op provider")
   149→			return
   150→		}
   151→
   152→		// Route OTel SDK errors (export failures, connection issues) through slog
   153→		// so they appear in debug logs alongside our own telemetry messages.
   154→		otel.SetErrorHandler(otel.ErrorHandlerFunc(func(err error) {
   155→			telemetryLogger().Warn("OTel SDK error", "error", err)
   156→		}))
   157→
   158→		serviceName := opts.ServiceName
   159→		if serviceName == "" {
   160→			serviceName = "specstory-cli"
   161→		}
   162→
   163→		// Parse the endpoint to extract a bare host:port for WithEndpoint and
   164→		// determine TLS mode from the scheme. OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is
   165→		// conventionally a full URL (e.g. "http://localhost:4317"), but
   166→		// WithEndpoint expects just "host:port".
   167→		host, insecure := parseEndpoint(opts.Endpoint)
   168→
   169→		// Create shared resource for both traces and metrics.
   170→		// Use resource.New() with detectors to pick up OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES env var.
   171→		res, err := resource.New(ctx,
   172→			resource.WithFromEnv(),      // OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES and OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
   173→			resource.WithTelemetrySDK(), // telemetry.sdk.* attributes
   174→			resource.WithHost(),         // host.* attributes
   175→			resource.WithAttributes(attribute.String("service.name", serviceName)), // explicit service name (can override env)
   176→		)
   177→		if err != nil {
   178→			initErr = fmt.Errorf("create OTel resource: %w", err)
   179→			return
   180→		}
   181→
   182→		// Log the resource attributes for debugging
   183→		telemetryLogger().Debug("Resource attributes created",
   184→			"attributes", res.Attributes(),
   185→			"OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", os.Getenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES"),
   186→		)
   187→
   188→		// Initialize tracing
   189→		if err := initTracing(ctx, host, insecure, res); err != nil {
   190→			initErr = err
   191→			return
   192→		}
   193→
   194→		// Initialize metrics
   195→		if err := initMetrics(ctx, host, insecure, res); err != nil {
   196→			// Roll back tracing initialization to avoid half-initialized state
   197→			telemetryLogger().Warn("Metrics init failed, rolling back tracing", "error", err)
   198→			if traceProvider != nil {
   199→				if shutdownErr := traceProvider.Shutdown(ctx); shutdownErr != nil {
   200→					telemetryLogger().Warn("Failed to shutdown trace provider during rollback", "error", shutdownErr)
   201→				}
   202→				traceProvider = nil
   203→				// Use no-op provider instead of nil per OTel documentation
   204→				otel.SetTracerProvider(noop.NewTracerProvider())
   205→			}
   206→			initErr = err
   207→			return
   208→		}
   209→
   210→		metricsEnabled = true
   211→
   212→		// Parse OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES and store as common metric attributes.
   213→		// This ensures resource attributes appear as metric tags in backends like Datadog
   214→		// that may not automatically promote resource-level attributes to metric tags.
   215→		commonMetricAttrs = parseResourceAttributes()
   216→		if len(commonMetricAttrs) > 0 {
   217→			telemetryLogger().Debug("Parsed OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES for metrics",
   218→				"count", len(commonMetricAttrs),
   219→				"attributes", commonMetricAttrs,
   220→			)
   221→		}
   222→
   223→		telemetryLogger().Info("Telemetry initialised",
   224→			"endpoint", host,
   225→			"insecure", insecure,
   226→			"serviceName", serviceName,
   227→		)
   228→	})
   229→
   230→	return initErr
   231→}
   232→
   233→// initTracing sets up the trace provider and exporter.
   234→func initTracing(ctx context.Context, host string, insecure bool, res *resource.Resource) error {
   235→	exporterOpts := []otlptracegrpc.Option{
   236→		otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(host),
   237→	}
   238→	if insecure {
   239→		exporterOpts = append(exporterOpts, otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure())
   240→	}
   241→
   242→	exporter, err := otlptracegrpc.New(ctx, exporterOpts...)
   243→	if err != nil {
   244→		return fmt.Errorf("create OTLP trace exporter: %w", err)
   245→	}
   246→
   247→	traceProvider = sdktrace.NewTracerProvider(
   248→		sdktrace.WithBatcher(exporter),
   249→		sdktrace.WithResource(res),
   250→	)
   251→	otel.SetTracerProvider(traceProvider)
   252→
   253→	return nil
   254→}

   256→// initMetrics sets up the meter provider, exporter, and metric instruments.
   257→func initMetrics(ctx context.Context, host string, insecure bool, res *resource.Resource) error {
   258→	exporterOpts := []otlpmetricgrpc.Option{
   259→		otlpmetricgrpc.WithEndpoint(host),
   260→	}
   261→	if insecure {
   262→		exporterOpts = append(exporterOpts, otlpmetricgrpc.WithInsecure())
   263→	}
   264→
   265→	exporter, err := otlpmetricgrpc.New(ctx, exporterOpts...)
   266→	if err != nil {
   267→		return fmt.Errorf("create OTLP metric exporter: %w", err)
   268→	}
   269→
   270→	meterProvider = sdkmetric.NewMeterProvider(
   271→		sdkmetric.WithResource(res),
   272→		sdkmetric.WithReader(sdkmetric.NewPeriodicReader(exporter,
   273→			sdkmetric.WithInterval(metricExportInterval),
   274→		)),
   275→	)
   276→	otel.SetMeterProvider(meterProvider)
   277→
   278→	meter = meterProvider.Meter("specstory-cli")
   279→
   280→	// Initialize metric instruments
   281→	if err := initMetricInstruments(); err != nil {
   282→		return fmt.Errorf("create metric instruments: %w", err)
   283→	}
   284→
   285→	return nil
   286→}

   419→// Shutdown flushes pending spans/metrics and shuts down both providers.
   420→// Safe to call even when Init was never called or telemetry is disabled.
   421→// For short-lived CLIs, this performs explicit ForceFlush calls before shutdown
   422→// to ensure all data is exported before the process exits.
   423→func Shutdown(ctx context.Context) error {
   424→	var errs []error
   425→
   426→	if traceProvider != nil {
   427→		telemetryLogger().Info("Flushing and shutting down trace provider")
   428→		// ForceFlush ensures all pending spans are exported before shutdown.
   429→		// This is critical for short-lived CLIs that may exit before the
   430→		// periodic exporter has time to run.
   431→		if err := traceProvider.ForceFlush(ctx); err != nil {
   432→			telemetryLogger().Warn("Failed to flush trace provider", "error", err)
   433→		}
   434→		if err := traceProvider.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
   435→			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("shutdown trace provider: %w", err))
   436→		}
   437→	}
   438→
   439→	if meterProvider != nil {
   440→		telemetryLogger().Info("Flushing and shutting down meter provider")
   441→		// ForceFlush ensures all pending metrics are exported before shutdown.
   442→		// The periodic reader has a 10-second interval, so without this,
   443→		// metrics from short CLI runs would never be sent.
   444→		if err := meterProvider.ForceFlush(ctx); err != nil {
   445→			telemetryLogger().Warn("Failed to flush meter provider", "error", err)
   446→		}
   447→		if err := meterProvider.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
   448→			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("shutdown meter provider: %w", err))
   449→		}
   450→	}
   451→
   452→	return errors.Join(errs...)
   453→}
   454→
   455→// ForceFlush explicitly flushes all pending spans and metrics.
   456→// Call this at the end of short-lived commands to ensure data is exported
   457→// before the command returns. Safe to call when telemetry is disabled.
   458→func ForceFlush(ctx context.Context) error {
   459→	var errs []error
   460→
   461→	if traceProvider != nil {
   462→		telemetryLogger().Debug("Force flushing trace provider")
   463→		if err := traceProvider.ForceFlush(ctx); err != nil {
   464→			telemetryLogger().Warn("Failed to force flush trace provider", "error", err)
   465→			errs = append(errs, err)
   466→		}
   467→	}
   468→
   469→	if meterProvider != nil {
   470→		telemetryLogger().Debug("Force flushing meter provider")
   471→		if err := meterProvider.ForceFlush(ctx); err != nil {
   472→			telemetryLogger().Warn("Failed to force flush meter provider", "error", err)
   473→			errs = append(errs, err)
   474→		}
   475→	}
   476→
   477→	return errors.Join(errs...)
   478→}

   480→// Tracer returns a named tracer from the global provider. When telemetry is
   481→// disabled the returned tracer is a no-op (standard OTel behaviour).
   482→func Tracer(name string) trace.Tracer {
   483→	return otel.Tracer(name)
   484→}

   486→// Meter returns the meter instance. When telemetry is disabled, returns the
   487→// global no-op meter.
   488→func Meter() metric.Meter {
   489→	if meter != nil {
   490→		return meter
   491→	}
   492→	return otel.Meter("specstory-cli")
   493→}
   494→
   495→// ContextWithSessionTrace returns a context that will cause any spans started
   496→// from it to share the same trace ID (derived deterministically from sessionID).
   497→// This groups all spans for a given session into a single trace, even across
   498→// multiple invocations (e.g., in autosave mode where processSingleSession is
   499→// called repeatedly as the session file grows).
   500→func ContextWithSessionTrace(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) context.Context {
   501→	traceID := traceIDFromSessionID(sessionID)
   502→	spanID := spanIDFromSessionID(sessionID)
   503→
   504→	// Create a SpanContext with both deterministic trace ID and span ID.
   505→	// In OpenTelemetry-Go, a SpanContext is only valid if both TraceID and SpanID
   506→	// are valid. We mark it as Remote so child spans inherit the trace ID.
   507→	sc := trace.NewSpanContext(trace.SpanContextConfig{
   508→		TraceID:    traceID,
   509→		SpanID:     spanID,
   510→		TraceFlags: trace.FlagsSampled, // Ensure it's sampled
   511→		Remote:     true,               // Mark as remote parent
   512→	})
   513→
   514→	// Inject the SpanContext as a remote parent so child spans inherit the trace ID
   515→	return trace.ContextWithRemoteSpanContext(ctx, sc)
   516→}
   517→
   518→// traceIDFromSessionID generates a deterministic 16-byte trace ID from a session ID
   519→// by hashing the session ID with SHA-256 and taking the first 16 bytes.
   520→func traceIDFromSessionID(sessionID string) trace.TraceID {
   521→	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(sessionID))
   522→	var traceID trace.TraceID
   523→	copy(traceID[:], hash[:16])
   524→	return traceID
   525→}
   526→
   527→// spanIDFromSessionID generates a deterministic 8-byte span ID from a session ID
   528→// by hashing the session ID with SHA-256 and taking bytes 16-24.
   529→// This ensures the span ID is different from the trace ID but still deterministic.
   530→func spanIDFromSessionID(sessionID string) trace.SpanID {
   531→	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(sessionID))
   532→	var spanID trace.SpanID
   533→	copy(spanID[:], hash[16:24])
   534→	return spanID
   535→}

   537→// --- Metric Recording Functions ---
   538→// These are internal functions called by RecordSessionMetrics in session_helpers.go.
   539→// The metricsEnabled check is done once in RecordSessionMetrics.
   540→
   541→// buildMetricAttrs combines specific metric attributes with common attributes from OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES.
   542→func buildMetricAttrs(specific ...attribute.KeyValue) []attribute.KeyValue {
   543→	attrs := make([]attribute.KeyValue, 0, len(specific)+len(commonMetricAttrs))
   544→	attrs = append(attrs, specific...)
   545→	attrs = append(attrs, commonMetricAttrs...)
   546→	return attrs
   547→}
   548→
   549→// recordSessionProcessed increments the sessions processed counter.

   554→	)
   555→	sessionsProcessed.Add(ctx, 1, metric.WithAttributes(attrs...))

   585→// recordProcessingDuration records the session processing duration.

   594→// TokenUsage holds aggregated token counts for telemetry recording.
   595→// Different providers track different token types:
   596→//   - Claude Code: InputTokens, OutputTokens, CacheCreationInputTokens, CacheReadInputTokens
   597→//   - Codex CLI: InputTokens, OutputTokens, CachedInputTokens, ReasoningOutputTokens
   598→//   - Gemini CLI: InputTokens, OutputTokens, CachedTokens, ThoughtTokens, ToolTokens
   599→//   - Droid CLI: InputTokens, OutputTokens, CacheCreationInputTokens, CacheReadInputTokens, ThinkingTokens
   600→type TokenUsage struct {
   601→	// Common fields (all providers)
   602→	InputTokens  int
   603→	OutputTokens int
   604→
   605→	// Claude Code specific (also used by Droid CLI)
   606→	CacheCreationInputTokens int
   607→	CacheReadInputTokens     int
   608→
   609→	// Codex CLI specific
   610→	CachedInputTokens     int
   611→	ReasoningOutputTokens int
   612→
   613→	// Gemini CLI specific
   614→	CachedTokens  int
   615→	ThoughtTokens int
   616→	ToolTokens    int
   617→
   618→	// Droid CLI specific
   619→	ThinkingTokens int
   620→}
   621→
   622→// providerAttrs returns OTel span attributes for provider-specific token fields,
   623→// including only non-zero values to reduce telemetry noise. The prefix is the
   624→// attribute namespace (e.g. "specstory.session.tokens" or "specstory.exchange.tokens").
   625→func (u TokenUsage) providerAttrs(prefix string) []attribute.KeyValue {
   626→	var attrs []attribute.KeyValue
   627→	// Claude Code specific (also used by Droid CLI)
   628→	if u.CacheCreationInputTokens > 0 {
   629→		attrs = append(attrs, attribute.Int(prefix+".cache_creation", u.CacheCreationInputTokens))
   630→	}
   631→	if u.CacheReadInputTokens > 0 {
   632→		attrs = append(attrs, attribute.Int(prefix+".cache_read", u.CacheReadInputTokens))
   633→	}
   634→	// Codex CLI specific
   635→	if u.CachedInputTokens > 0 {
   636→		attrs = append(attrs, attribute.Int(prefix+".cached_input", u.CachedInputTokens))
   637→	}
   638→	if u.ReasoningOutputTokens > 0 {
   639→		attrs = append(attrs, attribute.Int(prefix+".reasoning_output", u.ReasoningOutputTokens))
   640→	}
   641→	// Gemini CLI specific
   642→	if u.CachedTokens > 0 {
   643→		attrs = append(attrs, attribute.Int(prefix+".cached", u.CachedTokens))
   644→	}
   645→	if u.ThoughtTokens > 0 {
   646→		attrs = append(attrs, attribute.Int(prefix+".thought", u.ThoughtTokens))
   647→	}
   648→	if u.ToolTokens > 0 {
   649→		attrs = append(attrs, attribute.Int(prefix+".tool", u.ToolTokens))
   650→	}
   651→	// Droid CLI specific
   652→	if u.ThinkingTokens > 0 {
   653→		attrs = append(attrs, attribute.Int(prefix+".thinking", u.ThinkingTokens))
   654→	}
   655→	return attrs
   656→}

   660→func recordTokenUsage(ctx context.Context, agent string, sessionID string, usage TokenUsage) {

   670→	if usage.OutputTokens > 0 {

   674→	// Claude Code specific

   677→	}

   680→	}
   681→
   682→	// Codex CLI specific
   683→	if usage.CachedInputTokens > 0 {
   684→		cachedInputTokens.Add(ctx, int64(usage.CachedInputTokens), metric.WithAttributes(attrs...))
   685→	}
   686→	if usage.ReasoningOutputTokens > 0 {
   687→		reasoningOutputTokens.Add(ctx, int64(usage.ReasoningOutputTokens), metric.WithAttributes(attrs...))
   688→	}
   689→
   690→	// Gemini CLI specific
   691→	if usage.CachedTokens > 0 {
   692→		cachedTokens.Add(ctx, int64(usage.CachedTokens), metric.WithAttributes(attrs...))
   693→	}
   694→	if usage.ThoughtTokens > 0 {

   696→	}
   697→	if usage.ToolTokens > 0 {

   701→	// Droid CLI specific

    98→// startProjectWatcher starts watching a specific project directory
    99→func startProjectWatcher(claudeProjectDir string) error {
   100→	slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Creating file watcher", "directory", claudeProjectDir)
   101→
   102→	// Create a new watcher
   103→	watcher, err := fsnotify.NewWatcher()
   104→	if err != nil {
   105→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create file watcher: %v", err)
   106→	}
   107→
   108→	// Increment wait group before starting goroutine
   109→	watcherWg.Add(1)
   110→
   111→	// Start watching in a goroutine
   112→	go func() {
   113→		// Decrement wait group when done
   114→		defer watcherWg.Done()
   115→
   116→		// Log when goroutine starts
   117→		slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Goroutine started")
   118→
   119→		// Defer cleanup
   120→		defer func() {
   121→			slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Goroutine exiting, closing watcher")
   122→			_ = watcher.Close() // Best effort cleanup; errors here are not recoverable
   123→		}()
   124→
   125→		// Check if project directory already exists
   126→		if _, err := os.Stat(claudeProjectDir); err == nil {
   127→			slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Project directory exists", "directory", claudeProjectDir)
   128→			// Claude Code triggers file system events when it starts writing, so we'll catch the session on the first write event.
   129→			slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Waiting for JSONL file system events")
   130→		} else {
   131→			// Project directory doesn't exist yet, watch parent directory (or other error)
   132→			parentDir := filepath.Dir(claudeProjectDir)
   133→			projectName := filepath.Base(claudeProjectDir)
   134→			slog.Warn("startProjectWatcher: Cannot access project directory, watching parent",
   135→				"error", err,
   136→				"parentDir", parentDir,
   137→				"projectName", projectName)
   138→
   139→			// Add parent directory to watcher
   140→			if err := watcher.Add(parentDir); err != nil {
   141→				log.UserError("Error watching parent directory: %v", err)
   142→				slog.Error("startProjectWatcher: Failed to watch parent directory", "error", err)
   143→				return
   144→			}
   145→
   146→			// Wait for project directory to be created
   147→			waitingForCreation := true
   148→			slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Now watching for events in parent directory")
   149→			for waitingForCreation {
   150→				select {
   151→				case <-watcherCtx.Done():
   152→					slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Context cancelled while waiting for directory creation")
   153→					return
   154→				case event, ok := <-watcher.Events:
   155→					if !ok {
   156→						slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Watcher events channel closed")
   157→						return
   158→					}
   159→					slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Parent directory event",
   160→						"operation", event.Op.String(),
   161→						"path", event.Name,
   162→						"lookingFor", projectName)
   163→					eventBaseName := filepath.Base(event.Name)
   164→					slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Event basename comparison",
   165→						"basename", eventBaseName,
   166→						"comparingWith", projectName,
   167→						"equalFold", strings.EqualFold(eventBaseName, projectName))
   168→					if event.Has(fsnotify.Create) && strings.EqualFold(filepath.Base(event.Name), projectName) {
   169→						slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Detected project directory creation",
   170→							"path", event.Name)
   171→						slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Initial scan disabled; waiting for JSONL events")
   172→						// Use the actual created directory name from the event
   173→						claudeProjectDir = filepath.Join(parentDir, filepath.Base(event.Name))
   174→						// Remove parent directory and continue to watch project directory
   175→						_ = watcher.Remove(parentDir) // OK if this fails; we're moving to project dir
   176→						waitingForCreation = false
   177→					}
   178→				case err, ok := <-watcher.Errors:
   179→					if !ok {
   180→						slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Watcher errors channel closed")
   181→						return
   182→					}
   183→					log.UserWarn("Watcher error while waiting for project directory: %v", err)
   184→					slog.Error("startProjectWatcher: Watcher error", "error", err)
   185→				}
   186→			}
   187→		}
   188→
   189→		// Add the project directory to the watcher
   190→		// Re-stat to get the actual directory name with correct case
   191→		actualProjectDir := claudeProjectDir
   192→		if entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Dir(claudeProjectDir)); err == nil {
   193→			baseName := filepath.Base(claudeProjectDir)
   194→			for _, entry := range entries {
   195→				if strings.EqualFold(entry.Name(), baseName) {
   196→					actualProjectDir = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(claudeProjectDir), entry.Name())
   197→					break
   198→				}
   199→			}
   200→		}
   201→		slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Now monitoring project directory for changes",
   202→			"directory", actualProjectDir)
   203→		if err := watcher.Add(actualProjectDir); err != nil {
   204→			log.UserWarn("Error watching project directory: %v", err)
   205→			slog.Error("startProjectWatcher: Failed to monitor directory", "error", err)
   206→			return
   207→		}
   208→		slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Successfully monitoring project directory for future changes")
   209→
   210→		// Watch for file events
   211→		for {
   212→			select {
   213→			case <-watcherCtx.Done():
   214→				slog.Info("startProjectWatcher: Context cancelled, stopping watcher")
   215→				return
   216→			case event, ok := <-watcher.Events:
   217→				if !ok {
   218→					return
   219→				}
   220→
   221→				// Only process JSONL files
   222→				if !strings.HasSuffix(event.Name, ".jsonl") {
   223→					continue
   224→				}
   225→
   226→				if !event.Has(fsnotify.Create) && !event.Has(fsnotify.Write) {
   227→					continue
   228→				}
   229→
   230→				// Handle different event types
   231→				switch {
   232→				case event.Has(fsnotify.Create):
   233→					slog.Info("New JSONL file created", "file", event.Name)
   234→					scanJSONLFiles(claudeProjectDir, event.Name)
   235→				case event.Has(fsnotify.Write):
   236→					slog.Info("JSONL file modified", "file", event.Name)
   237→					slog.Info("Triggering scan due to file modification")
   238→					scanJSONLFiles(claudeProjectDir, event.Name)
   239→				}
   240→
   241→			case err, ok := <-watcher.Errors:
   242→				if !ok {
   243→					return
   244→				}
   245→				log.UserError("Watcher error: %v", err)
   246→			}
   247→		}
   248→	}()
   249→
   250→	return nil
   251→}

   253→// scanJSONLFiles scans JSONL files and optionally filters processing to a specific changed file
   254→func scanJSONLFiles(claudeProjectDir string, changedFile ...string) {
   255→	// Ensure logs are flushed even if we panic
   256→	defer func() {
   257→		if r := recover(); r != nil {
   258→			log.UserWarn("PANIC in ScanJSONLFiles: %v", r)
   259→			slog.Error("ScanJSONLFiles: PANIC recovered", "panic", r)
   260→		}
   261→	}()
   262→
   263→	slog.Info("ScanJSONLFiles: === START SCAN ===", "timestamp", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339))
   264→	var targetFile string
   265→	if len(changedFile) > 0 && changedFile[0] != "" {
   266→		targetFile = changedFile[0]
   267→		slog.Info("ScanJSONLFiles: Scanning JSONL files with changed file",
   268→			"directory", claudeProjectDir,
   269→			"changedFile", targetFile)
   270→	} else {
   271→		slog.Info("ScanJSONLFiles: Scanning JSONL files", "directory", claudeProjectDir)
   272→	}
   273→	// Parse files and create history files:
   274→	parser := NewJSONLParser()
   275→	var targetSessionUuid string
   276→
   277→	// Set the target file for conditional debug output
   278→	if targetFile != "" {
   279→		SetDebugTargetFile(targetFile)
   280→		defer ClearDebugTargetFile()
   281→
   282→		sessionID, err := extractSessionIDFromFile(targetFile)
   283→		if err != nil {
   284→			slog.Warn("ScanJSONLFiles: Failed to extract session ID from file",
   285→				"file", targetFile,
   286→				"error", err)
   287→			slog.Info("ScanJSONLFiles: Skipping scan due to file read error", "file", targetFile)
   288→			return
   289→		}
   290→		if sessionID == "" {
   291→			slog.Info("ScanJSONLFiles: Skipping scan; session ID not present yet", "file", targetFile)
   292→			return
   293→		}
   294→		targetSessionUuid = sessionID
   295→		slog.Info("ScanJSONLFiles: Extracted session ID from changed file",
   296→			"sessionUuid", targetSessionUuid,
   297→			"file", targetFile)
   298→	}
   299→
   300→	var parseErr error
   301→	if targetSessionUuid != "" {
   302→		parseErr = parser.ParseProjectSessionsForSession(claudeProjectDir, true, targetSessionUuid)
   303→	} else {
   304→		parseErr = parser.ParseProjectSessions(claudeProjectDir, true)
   305→	}
   306→	if parseErr != nil {
   307→		log.UserWarn("Error parsing project sessions: %v", parseErr)
   308→		slog.Error("ScanJSONLFiles: Error parsing project sessions", "error", parseErr)
   309→		return
   310→	}
   311→
   312→	// Process JSONL sessions (isAutosave = true, silent = false for autosave)
   313→	slog.Info("ScanJSONLFiles: Processing sessions",
   314→		"sessionCount", len(parser.Sessions),
   315→		"targetSessionUuid", targetSessionUuid)
   316→
   317→	// Get the session callback
   318→	callback := getWatcherCallback()
   319→	if callback == nil {
   320→		slog.Error("ScanJSONLFiles: No callback provided - this should not happen")
   321→		return
   322→	}
   323→
   324→	slog.Info("ScanJSONLFiles: Processing sessions with callback")
   325→	// Process sessions and call the callback for each
   326→	for _, session := range parser.Sessions {
   327→		// Skip empty sessions
   328→		if len(session.Records) == 0 {
   329→			continue
   330→		}
   331→
   332→		// Skip if we're targeting a specific session and this isn't it
   333→		if targetSessionUuid != "" && session.SessionUuid != targetSessionUuid {
   334→			continue
   335→		}
   336→
   337→		// Convert to AgentChatSession (workspaceRoot extracted from records' cwd field)
   338→		agentSession := convertToAgentChatSession(session, "", getWatcherDebugRaw())
   339→		if agentSession != nil {
   340→			slog.Info("ScanJSONLFiles: Calling callback for session", "sessionId", agentSession.SessionID)
   341→			// Call the callback in a goroutine to avoid blocking
   342→			go func(s *spi.AgentChatSession) {
   343→				defer func() {
   344→					if r := recover(); r != nil {
   345→						slog.Error("ScanJSONLFiles: Callback panicked", "panic", r)
   346→					}
   347→				}()
   348→				callback(s)
   349→			}(agentSession)
   350→		}
   351→	}
   352→	slog.Info("ScanJSONLFiles: Processing complete")
   353→	slog.Info("ScanJSONLFiles: === END SCAN ===", "timestamp", time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339))
   354→}
   355→
   356→// WatchForClaudeSetup watches for the creation of Claude directories
   357→func WatchForClaudeSetup() error {
   358→	slog.Info("WatchForClaudeSetup: Starting Claude directory setup watcher")
   359→	homeDir, err := os.UserHomeDir()
   360→	if err != nil {
   361→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get user home directory: %v", err)
   362→	}
   363→
   364→	claudeDir := filepath.Join(homeDir, ".claude")
   365→	projectsDir := filepath.Join(claudeDir, "projects")
   366→	slog.Info("WatchForClaudeSetup: Directories",
   367→		"homeDir", homeDir,
   368→		"claudeDir", claudeDir,
   369→		"projectsDir", projectsDir)
   370→
   371→	// Determine what to watch
   372→	var watchDir string
   373→	var watchingFor string
   374→
   375→	if _, err := os.Stat(claudeDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
   376→		// .claude doesn't exist, watch home directory
   377→		watchDir = homeDir
   378→		watchingFor = ".claude"
   379→		slog.Warn("WatchForClaudeSetup: .claude directory does not exist")
   380→		slog.Info("Claude directory not found, watching for creation of ~/.claude\n")
   381→	} else {
   382→		// .claude exists but projects doesn't, watch .claude
   383→		watchDir = claudeDir
   384→		watchingFor = "projects"
   385→		slog.Warn("WatchForClaudeSetup: .claude directory exists, checking for projects")
   386→		slog.Info("Claude directory found, watching for creation of ~/.claude/projects\n")
   387→	}
   388→	slog.Info("WatchForClaudeSetup: Will watch directory",
   389→		"watchDir", watchDir,
   390→		"watchingFor", watchingFor)
   391→
   392→	// Create watcher
   393→	watcher, err := fsnotify.NewWatcher()
   394→	if err != nil {
   395→		log.UserWarn("Failed to create file watcher: %v", err)
   396→		slog.Error("WatchForClaudeSetup: Failed to create file watcher", "error", err)
   397→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create file watcher: %v", err)
   398→	}
   399→
   400→	// Add directory to watch
   401→	slog.Info("WatchForClaudeSetup: Adding directory to watcher", "directory", watchDir)
   402→	if err := watcher.Add(watchDir); err != nil {
   403→		_ = watcher.Close() // Clean up on error; close errors less important than Add error
   404→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to watch directory %s: %v", watchDir, err)
   405→	}
   406→	slog.Info("WatchForClaudeSetup: Successfully started watching", "directory", watchDir)
   407→
   408→	// Start watching in a goroutine
   409→	go func() {
   410→		defer func() { _ = watcher.Close() }() // Cleanup on exit; errors not recoverable
   411→
   412→		for {
   413→			select {
   414→			case event, ok := <-watcher.Events:
   415→				if !ok {
   416→					return
   417→				}
   418→
   419→				slog.Info("WatchForClaudeSetup: Received event",
   420→					"operation", event.Op.String(),
   421→					"path", event.Name)
   422→				// Check if this is the directory we're waiting for (case-insensitive)
   423→				if event.Has(fsnotify.Create) && strings.EqualFold(filepath.Base(event.Name), watchingFor) {
   424→					slog.Info("Detected creation", "path", event.Name)
   425→					slog.Info("WatchForClaudeSetup: Target directory created", "path", event.Name)
   426→
   427→					// Wait a second to let things settle
   428→					slog.Info("WatchForClaudeSetup: Waiting 1 second for things to settle")
   429→					time.Sleep(1 * time.Second)
   430→
   431→					// Check what we should do next
   432→					if watchingFor == ".claude" {
   433→						slog.Info("WatchForClaudeSetup: .claude was created, checking if projects exists")
   434→						// We were watching for .claude, now check if projects exists
   435→						if _, err := os.Stat(projectsDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
   436→							slog.Info("WatchForClaudeSetup: projects directory does not exist, switching watcher")
   437→							// Need to watch for projects directory
   438→							_ = watcher.Remove(watchDir) // OK if fails; switching watch targets
   439→							watchDir = claudeDir
   440→							watchingFor = "projects"
   441→							slog.Info("WatchForClaudeSetup: Switching to watch",
   442→								"watchDir", watchDir,
   443→								"watchingFor", watchingFor)
   444→							if err := watcher.Add(watchDir); err != nil {
   445→								log.UserWarn("Error switching to watch .claude directory: %v", err)
   446→								slog.Error("WatchForClaudeSetup: Failed to switch watcher", "error", err)
   447→								return
   448→							}
   449→							slog.Info("Now watching for creation of ~/.claude/projects\n")
   450→							continue
   451→						} else {
   452→							slog.Info("WatchForClaudeSetup: projects directory already exists!")
   453→						}
   454→					}
   455→
   456→					// If we get here, projects directory should exist
   457→					slog.Info("WatchForClaudeSetup: Projects directory should now exist, cleaning up watcher")
   458→					// Remove the current watcher
   459→					_ = watcher.Remove(watchDir) // OK if fails; we're transitioning to project watcher

   472→						}
   473→					} else {
   474→						log.UserWarn("Error getting project directory after Claude setup: %v", err)
   475→						slog.Error("WatchForClaudeSetup: Failed to get project directory", "error", err)
   476→					}
   477→					return
   478→				}
   479→
   480→			case err, ok := <-watcher.Errors:
   481→				if !ok {
   482→					return
   483→				}
   484→				log.UserWarn("Watcher error: %v", err)
   485→				slog.Error("WatchForClaudeSetup: Watcher error", "error", err)
   486→			}
   487→		}
   488→	}()
   489→
   490→	return nil
   491→}
   492→
   493→// convertToAgentChatSession converts a Session to an AgentChatSession
   494→// Returns nil if the session is warmup-only (no real messages)
   495→func convertToAgentChatSession(session Session, workspaceRoot string, debugRaw bool) *spi.AgentChatSession {
   496→	// Skip empty sessions (no records)
   497→	if len(session.Records) == 0 {
   498→		return nil
   499→	}
   500→
   501→	// Write debug files first (even for warmup-only sessions)
   502→	_ = make(map[int]int) // recordToFileNumber no longer needed
   503→	if debugRaw {
   504→		// Write debug files
   505→		writeDebugRawFiles(session)
   506→	}
   507→
   508→	// Filter warmup messages
   509→	filteredRecords := filterWarmupMessages(session.Records)
   510→
   511→	// Skip if no real messages remain after filtering warmup
   512→	if len(filteredRecords) == 0 {
   513→		slog.Debug("Skipping warmup-only session", "sessionId", session.SessionUuid)
   514→		return nil
   515→	}
   516→
   517→	// Create session with filtered records
   518→	filteredSession := Session{
   519→		SessionUuid: session.SessionUuid,
   520→		Records:     filteredRecords,
   521→	}
   522→
   523→	// Get timestamp from root record
   524→	rootRecord := filteredSession.Records[0]
   525→	timestamp, ok := rootRecord.Data["timestamp"].(string)
   526→	if !ok {
   527→		slog.Warn("convertToAgentChatSession: No timestamp found in root record")
   528→		return nil
   529→	}
   530→
   531→	// Get the slug
   532→	slug := FileSlugFromRootRecord(filteredSession)
   533→
   534→	// Generate SessionData from filtered session
   535→	sessionData, err := GenerateAgentSession(filteredSession, workspaceRoot)
   536→	if err != nil {
   537→		slog.Error("Failed to generate SessionData", "sessionId", session.SessionUuid, "error", err)
   538→		return nil
   539→	}
   540→
   541→	// Convert session records to JSONL format for raw data
   542→	// Note: Uses unfiltered session.Records (not filteredSession.Records) to preserve
   543→	// all records including warmup messages in the raw data for complete audit trail
   544→	var rawDataBuilder strings.Builder
   545→	for _, record := range session.Records {
   546→		jsonBytes, _ := json.Marshal(record.Data)
   547→		rawDataBuilder.Write(jsonBytes)
   548→		rawDataBuilder.WriteString("\n")
   549→	}
   550→
   551→	return &spi.AgentChatSession{
   552→		SessionID:   session.SessionUuid,
   553→		CreatedAt:   timestamp, // ISO 8601 timestamp
   554→		Slug:        slug,
   555→		SessionData: sessionData,
   556→		RawData:     rawDataBuilder.String(),
   557→	}
   558→}

    11→
    12→// GetClaudeCodeProjectsDir returns the path to the Claude Code projects directory
    13→func GetClaudeCodeProjectsDir() (string, error) {
    14→	// Get user's home directory
    15→	homeDir, err := os.UserHomeDir()
    16→	if err != nil {
    17→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get user home directory: %v", err)
    18→	}
    19→
    20→	// Construct the path to .claude/projects
    21→	projectsDir := filepath.Join(homeDir, ".claude", "projects")
    22→
    23→	// Check if the directory exists
    24→	if _, err := os.Stat(projectsDir); err != nil {
    25→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
    26→			return "", fmt.Errorf("claude projects directory not found at %s", projectsDir)
    27→		}
    28→		return "", fmt.Errorf("error checking Claude projects directory: %v", err)
    29→	}
    30→
    31→	return projectsDir, nil
    32→}
    33→
    34→// GetClaudeCodeProjectDir returns the Claude Code project directory for the given path.
    35→// If no path is provided (empty string), it uses the current working directory.
    36→// It resolves any symlinks in the path to match Claude Code's behavior, which uses the real path
    37→// when creating project directories. Claude Code requires a specific naming convention to map
    38→// working directories to project folders: each non-alphanumeric character is replaced with a dash
    39→// to create a unique, filesystem-safe identifier
    40→func GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath string) (string, error) {
    41→	// Use provided path or get current working directory
    42→	var cwd string
    43→	var err error
    44→	if projectPath == "" {
    45→		cwd, err = os.Getwd()
    46→		if err != nil {
    47→			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get current working directory: %v", err)
    48→		}
    49→	} else {
    50→		cwd = projectPath
    51→	}
    52→
    53→	// Resolve any symlinks in the path to match Claude Code's behavior
    54→	// Claude Code uses the real path when creating project directories, so
    55→	// if the user's working directory contains symlinks, we need to resolve
    56→	// them to find the correct project directory in ~/.claude/projects/
    57→	realPath, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cwd)
    58→	if err != nil {
    59→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve symlinks in working directory: %v", err)
    60→	}
    61→
    62→	// Log if the path was changed by symlink resolution
    63→	if realPath != cwd {
    64→		slog.Debug("GetClaudeCodeProjectDir: Resolved symlinks in working directory",
    65→			"original", cwd,
    66→			"resolved", realPath)
    67→	}
    68→
    69→	// Convert path to project directory format using regex
    70→	// Replace anything that's not alphanumeric or dash with a dash (matching Claude Code's behavior)
    71→	// Example: "/Users/sean/My Projects(1)/app" becomes "-Users-sean-My-Projects-1--app"
    72→	reg := regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-zA-Z0-9-]`)
    73→	projectDirName := reg.ReplaceAllString(realPath, "-")
    74→
    75→	// Add leading dash if not already there
    76→	if !strings.HasPrefix(projectDirName, "-") {
    77→		projectDirName = "-" + projectDirName
    78→	}
    79→
    80→	// Log the transformation for debugging path issues
    81→	slog.Debug("GetClaudeCodeProjectDir: Transformed working directory to project name",
    82→		"cwd", cwd,
    83→		"projectDirName", projectDirName)
    84→
    85→	// Get Claude projects directory
    86→	projectsDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectsDir()
    87→	if err != nil {
    88→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get Claude projects directory: %v", err)
    89→	}
    90→
    91→	fullProjectPath := filepath.Join(projectsDir, projectDirName)
    92→	slog.Debug("GetClaudeCodeProjectDir: Constructed full project path",
    93→		"projectPath", fullProjectPath)
    94→
    95→	return fullProjectPath, nil
    96→}
    97→

Now I have a complete picture. Here's a comprehensive explanation of the system:

---

## How specstory-cli Works

### 1. The Provider Approach (SPI Pattern)

The CLI uses a **Service Provider Interface (SPI)** pattern to support multiple coding agents uniformly.

**`pkg/spi/provider.go`** defines the `Provider` interface that every agent integration must implement:

```
Provider interface:
  Name()                   → human-readable name
  Check()                  → verify the agent is installed
  DetectAgent()            → check if agent has been used in this project
  GetAgentChatSession()    → fetch one session by ID
  GetAgentChatSessions()   → fetch all sessions
  ListAgentChatSessions()  → lightweight metadata listing
  ExecAgentAndWatch()      → launch agent + watch for updates (interactive mode)
  WatchAgent()             → watch only, don't launch
```

**`pkg/spi/factory/registry.go`** is the single place where all providers are registered:
- `"claude"` → `claudecode.Provider`
- `"cursor"` → `cursorcli.Provider`
- `"codex"` → `codexcli.Provider`
- `"gemini"` → `geminicli.Provider`
- `"droid"` → `droidcli.Provider`

Each provider in `pkg/providers/<name>/` knows how to find and parse that agent's data files. For Claude Code specifically:

- **Path mapping** (`path_utils.go:40`): Takes the current working directory, resolves symlinks, then replaces every non-alphanumeric character with `-` to derive the path `~/.claude/projects/<dir-derived-name>/`
- **Parsing** (`jsonl_parser.go`): Reads the JSONL session files Claude Code writes to that directory
- **Watcher** (`watcher.go`): Uses `fsnotify` to watch for `Create`/`Write` events on `.jsonl` files in that directory

---

### 2. How Chat Histories Are Saved to Disk

**In `run` mode** (interactive, real-time):

1. `specstory run` calls `provider.ExecAgentAndWatch()`, which:
   - Registers a `sessionCallback`
   - Starts the `fsnotify` watcher on `~/.claude/projects/<project-dir>/`
   - Executes the agent process (blocking)
2. When Claude Code writes to a `.jsonl` file, `scanJSONLFiles()` fires (`watcher.go:254`)
3. The JSONL records are parsed, warmup messages are filtered out, and a `spi.AgentChatSession` is assembled
4. The `sessionCallback` in `main.go:432` calls `session.ProcessSingleSession()`
5. `ProcessSingleSession()` (`session/session.go:82`):
   - Generates markdown from the structured `SessionData`
   - Builds a filename: `<timestamp>-<slug-from-first-user-message>.md`
   - Writes to `.specstory/history/<filename>.md`
   - Skips writing if the content is identical to the existing file

**In `sync` mode** (batch, after the fact):
- Same `ProcessSingleSession()` call, but triggered by reading all existing JSONL files at once rather than watching for changes.

---

### 3. Optional Cloud Sync

Cloud sync is handled by `pkg/cloud/sync.go` via the `SyncManager`.

**How it works:**
- After writing markdown locally, `ProcessSingleSession()` calls `cloud.SyncSessionToCloud()` with the session ID, file path, markdown content, and raw JSONL data
- The `SyncManager` checks if the user is authenticated (token stored locally from `specstory login`)
- It POTs to `https://cloud.specstory.com/api/v1/projects/<projectID>/sessions/<sessionID>`
- The payload is `{projectId, projectName, name, markdown, rawData, metadata}`

**Deduplication via content-length comparison:**
- In `sync` mode: a `HEAD` request checks the server's `X-Markdown-Size` header vs. local size — only syncs if local is larger
- In batch `sync` mode: a single `GET /sessions/sizes` call preloads all sizes to avoid N HEAD requests
- In `run` (autosave) mode: syncs are **debounced** (10 second window, `sync.go:35`) and skip the HEAD check since the content just changed

**Opt-out:** Pass `--no-cloud-sync` to disable entirely, or `--only-cloud-sync` to skip local disk writes and only push to cloud.

---

### 4. Optional OTel Traces

Telemetry lives in `pkg/telemetry/telemetry.go`. It's **opt-in** and uses a no-op provider by default (zero overhead when disabled).

**Activation:** Set `--telemetry-endpoint <otlp-grpc-host:port>` (or `http://`/`https://` URL). The endpoint is parsed to determine host:port and TLS mode.

**What gets emitted:**

*Metrics* (exported every 10s via OTLP gRPC):
- `specstory.sessions.processed` — counter per session
- `specstory.exchanges.processed`, `specstory.messages.processed`, `specstory.tools.used` — counters
- `specstory.session.duration` — histogram
- Token counters: `specstory.tokens.input`, `.output`, `.cache_creation`, `.cache_read`, etc. — provider-specific token types are tracked for Claude, Codex, Gemini, and Droid

*Traces* (OTLP gRPC):
- A `process_session` span per session
- Child spans per exchange
- Trace IDs are **deterministically derived from the session ID** (SHA-256 hash, `telemetry.go:520`) so all processing spans for the same session share one trace across multiple `run` invocations
- Resource attributes from `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` env var are applied to all metrics as tags (useful for Datadog etc.)

**Shutdown:** `telemetry.Shutdown()` calls `ForceFlush()` before shutdown to ensure data is exported before the short-lived CLI process exits.

---

# SpecStory CLI Architecture

## Component Architecture

\```mermaid
graph TB
    subgraph USER["User's Machine"]

        subgraph AGENTS["Coding Agents"]
            CC["Claude Code"]
            CX["Codex CLI"]
            CU["Cursor"]
            GE["Gemini CLI"]
            DR["Droid CLI"]
        end

        subgraph AGENT_DATA["Agent Session Data (read-only)"]
            JSONL["JSONL files\n~/.claude/projects/&lt;dir&gt;/*.jsonl\n~/.codex/sessions/…\n~/.gemini/…"]
            SQLITE["SQLite DB\nCursor workspace storage"]
        end

        subgraph CLI["specstory CLI (Go binary)"]

            subgraph CMD["Commands (pkg/cmd)"]
                RUN["specstory run\n(exec + watch)"]
                SYNC["specstory sync\n(batch)"]
                WATCH["specstory watch\n(watch only)"]
            end

            subgraph SPI["Provider SPI (pkg/spi)"]
                REG["Provider Registry\nfactory/registry.go"]
                IFACE["Provider Interface\nName · Check · DetectAgent\nGetAgentChatSession(s)\nExecAgentAndWatch · WatchAgent"]
            end

            subgraph PROVIDERS["Providers (pkg/providers/)"]
                direction LR
                PCC["claudecode\nJSONL parser\nfsnotify watcher"]
                PCX["codexcli\nJSONL parser\nfsnotify watcher"]
                PCU["cursorcli\nSQLite reader\nfsnotify watcher"]
                PGE["geminicli\nJSON parser\nfsnotify watcher"]
                PDR["droidcli\nJSON parser\nfsnotify watcher"]
            end

            subgraph PIPELINE["Session Processing Pipeline (pkg/session)"]
                AGG["AgentChatSession\n{SessionID · CreatedAt · Slug\nSessionData · RawData}"]
                PROC["ProcessSingleSession()"]
                MD["Markdown Generator\nGenerateMarkdownFromAgentSession()"]
            end

            subgraph TELEM["Telemetry (pkg/telemetry)  ◀── primary observability output"]
                TRACER["OTel Tracer\nprocess_session span\nper-exchange child spans\ndeterministic trace ID\nfrom session UUID"]
                METER["OTel Meter\nMetric instruments"]
                METRICS["Counters\nspecstory.sessions.processed\nspecstory.exchanges.processed\nspecstory.messages.processed\nspecstory.tools.used\nspecstory.tokens.{input·output·cache_*}\n\nHistogram\nspecstory.session.duration"]
            end

            PROV["AI Provenance\n(pkg/provenance)\nfile-change correlation"]
            CFG["Config (pkg/config)\nTOML · project identity"]
        end

        subgraph DISK["Local Disk Output"]
            HISTORY[".specstory/history/\n&lt;timestamp&gt;-&lt;slug&gt;.md\nMarkdown chat history"]
            PROJJSON[".specstory/.project.json\nproject identity"]
        end

        subgraph OTEL_LOCAL["OTel Collector (local or sidecar)"]
            COL["OTLP gRPC receiver\nlocalhost:4317 (default)"]
        end

    end

    subgraph BACKENDS["Observability Backends"]
        DD["Datadog"]
        JA["Jaeger"]
        PY["Prometheus / Grafana"]
        ANY["Any OTLP-compatible backend"]
    end

    CLOUD["SpecStory Cloud\n(optional · --no-cloud-sync to disable)"]

    %% Agent → data files
    CC & CX & CU & GE & DR -->|writes session data| JSONL
    CU -->|writes session data| SQLITE

    %% Data files → providers via fsnotify
    JSONL -->|fsnotify Create/Write events| PCC & PCX & PGE & PDR
    SQLITE -->|fsnotify + SQLite read| PCU

    %% CMD → registry → providers
    CMD --> REG
    REG --> IFACE
    IFACE --- PCC & PCX & PCU & PGE & PDR

    %% Providers → unified session struct
    PCC & PCX & PCU & PGE & PDR -->|AgentChatSession| AGG

    %% Processing pipeline
    AGG --> PROC
    PROC --> MD
    MD -->|os.WriteFile| HISTORY
    PROC --> PROV

    %% Telemetry path (emphasized)
    PROC ==>|start span\nset attributes| TRACER
    PROC ==>|record counters\nrecord histogram| METER
    METER --- METRICS
    TRACER ==>|OTLP gRPC\nbatched spans| COL
    METER ==>|OTLP gRPC\n10s periodic export| COL
    COL --> DD & JA & PY & ANY

    %% Config
    CFG --> PROJJSON
    CFG -.-> PROC

    %% Cloud (minimized)
    PROC -.->|optional PUT\n/api/v1/projects/{id}/sessions/{id}| CLOUD

    %% Style
    classDef telem fill:#d4edda,stroke:#28a745,stroke-width:2px
    classDef disk fill:#cce5ff,stroke:#004085,stroke-width:2px
    classDef cloud fill:#f8f9fa,stroke:#6c757d,stroke-width:1px,stroke-dasharray:4
    classDef provider fill:#fff3cd,stroke:#856404,stroke-width:1px

    class TRACER,METER,METRICS,TELEM telem
    class HISTORY,DISK disk
    class CLOUD cloud
    class PCC,PCX,PCU,PGE,PDR provider
\```

## Data Flow: `specstory run` (Interactive Auto-save)

\```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant User
    participant CLI as specstory CLI
    participant Agent as Coding Agent<br/>(e.g. Claude Code)
    participant FS as Agent JSONL File<br/>~/.claude/projects/…/&lt;uuid&gt;.jsonl
    participant Watch as fsnotify Watcher<br/>(goroutine)
    participant Provider as Provider<br/>(claudecode pkg)
    participant Pipeline as ProcessSingleSession()
    participant Disk as .specstory/history/
    participant OTel as OTel SDK
    participant Col as OTLP Collector

    User->>CLI: specstory run
    CLI->>Agent: exec claude (subprocess)
    CLI->>Watch: start fsnotify on<br/>~/.claude/projects/&lt;dir&gt;/

    loop Each user–agent exchange
        User->>Agent: types prompt
        Agent->>FS: appends JSONL records
        FS-->>Watch: Write event (inotify/kqueue)
        Watch->>Provider: scanJSONLFiles(changedFile)
        Provider->>FS: read + parse JSONL records
        Provider->>Provider: filter warmup messages<br/>extract sessionID · slug · timestamp
        Provider->>Provider: GenerateAgentSession()<br/>→ structured SessionData
        Provider-->>Pipeline: AgentChatSession{<br/>  SessionID, CreatedAt, Slug,<br/>  SessionData, RawData}

        Pipeline->>OTel: ContextWithSessionTrace()<br/>(deterministic TraceID from sessionID)
        Pipeline->>OTel: tracer.Start("process_session")<br/>→ span with session attributes

        loop Each exchange in SessionData
            Pipeline->>OTel: child span per exchange<br/>(model · input/output tokens · tools)
        end

        Pipeline->>OTel: record metrics<br/>sessions+1 · exchanges+N<br/>messages+N · tools+N<br/>tokens{input·output·cache}+N<br/>duration histogram

        Pipeline->>Pipeline: GenerateMarkdownFromAgentSession()
        Pipeline->>Disk: os.WriteFile(.specstory/history/<br/>&lt;timestamp&gt;-&lt;slug&gt;.md)<br/>(skips if content identical)

        Pipeline->>OTel: span.End()
        OTel-->>Col: OTLP gRPC (batched spans)<br/>OTLP gRPC (metrics every 10s)
    end

    Agent-->>CLI: exits
    CLI->>Watch: StopWatcher()
    CLI->>OTel: ForceFlush() + Shutdown()<br/>(ensures export before process exit)
    OTel-->>Col: flush remaining spans + metrics
\```

---

## Data Flow: `specstory sync` (Batch Post-processing)

\```mermaid
flowchart TD
    START([specstory sync]) --> DETECT

    DETECT["DetectAgent(projectPath)\nfor each registered provider"]
    DETECT -->|provider has sessions| LOAD
    DETECT -->|no activity| SKIP([skip provider])

    LOAD["GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath)\nparse ALL session files\nwith progress callback"]

    LOAD --> LOOP

    subgraph LOOP["For each AgentChatSession"]
        direction TB

        TRACE["telemetry.ContextWithSessionTrace()\ndeterministic TraceID\nfrom sessionID SHA-256"]
        SPAN["tracer.Start('process_session')\nset span attributes\n{agent · sessionID · exchanges\ntoolCount · tokenCounts}"]
        CHILD["ProcessExchangeSpans()\nchild span per exchange\n{model · promptTokens\ncompletionTokens · tools}"]
        METRICS["RecordSessionMetrics()\nsessions.processed +1\nexchanges, messages, tools +N\ntokens.{input·output·cache} +N\nsession.duration histogram"]

        MDGEN["GenerateMarkdownFromAgentSession()\nrender structured SessionData\nto markdown string"]

        EXISTS{".md file\nalready exists?"}
        SAME{"content\nidentical?"}
        WRITE["os.WriteFile()\n.specstory/history/\n&lt;timestamp&gt;-&lt;slug&gt;.md"]
        NOOP["skip write\n(up to date)"]

        CLOUD["SyncSessionToCloud()\nPUT /api/v1/projects/{id}/sessions/{id}\nHEAD check first\n(optional — skipped if not authed\nor --no-cloud-sync)"]

        TRACE --> SPAN --> CHILD --> METRICS
        METRICS --> MDGEN --> EXISTS
        EXISTS -->|no| WRITE
        EXISTS -->|yes| SAME
        SAME -->|no - local larger| WRITE
        SAME -->|yes| NOOP
        WRITE -.-> CLOUD
        NOOP -.-> CLOUD
    end

    LOOP --> FLUSH

    FLUSH["telemetry.ForceFlush()\ntelemetry.Shutdown()\nexport all pending\nspans + metrics"]

    FLUSH --> COL["OTLP Collector\n(Datadog · Jaeger · Prometheus…)"]

    style TRACE fill:#d4edda,stroke:#28a745
    style SPAN fill:#d4edda,stroke:#28a745
    style CHILD fill:#d4edda,stroke:#28a745
    style METRICS fill:#d4edda,stroke:#28a745
    style FLUSH fill:#d4edda,stroke:#28a745
    style COL fill:#d4edda,stroke:#28a745
    style CLOUD fill:#f8f9fa,stroke:#adb5bd,stroke-dasharray:4
    style WRITE fill:#cce5ff,stroke:#004085
    style NOOP fill:#cce5ff,stroke:#004085
\```

                PGE["geminicli\nJSON parser\nfsnotify watcher"]
                PDR["droidcli\nJSON parser\nfsnotify watcher"]
            end
            subgraph PIPELINE["Session Processing Pipeline  (pkg/session)"]
                AGG["AgentChatSession\nSessionID, CreatedAt, Slug\nSessionData, RawData"]
                PROC["ProcessSingleSession()"]
                MD["Markdown Generator\nGenerateMarkdownFromAgentSession()"]
            end
            subgraph TELEM["Telemetry  (pkg/telemetry)  — primary observability output"]
                TRACER["OTel Tracer\nprocess_session span\nper-exchange child spans\ndeterministic trace ID\nfrom session UUID"]
                METER["OTel Meter\nMetric instruments"]
                METRICS["Counters\nspecstory.sessions.processed\nspecstory.exchanges.processed\nspecstory.messages.processed\nspecstory.tools.used\nspecstory.tokens.input / output / cache\nHistogram\nspecstory.session.duration"]
            end
            PROV["AI Provenance\npkg/provenance\nfile-change correlation"]
            CFG["Config  (pkg/config)\nTOML, project identity"]
        end
        subgraph DISK["Local Disk Output"]
            HISTORY[".specstory/history/\nTIMESTAMP-SLUG.md\nMarkdown chat history"]
            PROJJSON[".specstory/.project.json\nproject identity"]
        end
        subgraph OTEL_LOCAL["OTel Collector  (local or sidecar)"]
            COL["OTLP gRPC receiver\nlocalhost:4317  (default)"]
        end
    end
    subgraph BACKENDS["Observability Backends"]
        DD["Datadog"]
        JA["Jaeger"]
        PY["Prometheus / Grafana"]
        ANY["Any OTLP-compatible backend"]
    end
    CLOUD["SpecStory Cloud\noptional — disable with --no-cloud-sync"]

    CC & CX & CU & GE & DR -->|writes session data| JSONL
    CU -->|writes session data| SQLITE

    JSONL -->|fsnotify Create/Write events| PCC & PCX & PGE & PDR
    SQLITE -->|fsnotify + SQLite read| PCU

    CMD --> REG
    REG --> IFACE
    IFACE --- PCC & PCX & PCU & PGE & PDR

    PCC & PCX & PCU & PGE & PDR -->|AgentChatSession| AGG

    AGG --> PROC
    PROC --> MD
    MD -->|os.WriteFile| HISTORY
    PROC --> PROV

    PROC ==>|start span + set attributes| TRACER
    PROC ==>|record metrics| METER
    METER --- METRICS
    TRACER ==>|OTLP gRPC spans| COL
    METER ==>|OTLP gRPC metrics every 10s| COL
    COL --> DD & JA & PY & ANY

    CFG --> PROJJSON
    CFG -.-> PROC

    PROC -.->|optional cloud sync| CLOUD

## Data Flow: `specstory run`  (Interactive Auto-save)

\```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant User
    participant CLI as specstory CLI
    participant Agent as Coding Agent
    participant FS as Agent JSONL File
    participant Watch as fsnotify Watcher
    participant Provider as Provider
    participant Pipeline as ProcessSingleSession
    participant Disk as .specstory/history/
    participant OTel as OTel SDK
    participant Col as OTLP Collector

    User->>CLI: specstory run
    CLI->>Agent: exec claude (subprocess)
    CLI->>Watch: start fsnotify on ~/.claude/projects/DIR/

    loop Each user-agent exchange
        User->>Agent: types prompt
        Agent->>FS: appends JSONL records
        FS-->>Watch: Write event (inotify/kqueue)
        Watch->>Provider: scanJSONLFiles(changedFile)
        Provider->>FS: read + parse JSONL records
        Provider->>Provider: filter warmup messages, extract sessionID + slug + timestamp
        Provider->>Provider: GenerateAgentSession() to structured SessionData
        Provider-->>Pipeline: AgentChatSession with SessionID, CreatedAt, Slug, SessionData, RawData

        Pipeline->>OTel: ContextWithSessionTrace() — deterministic TraceID from sessionID
        Pipeline->>OTel: tracer.Start(process_session) — span with session attributes

        loop Each exchange in SessionData
            Pipeline->>OTel: child span per exchange (model, input/output tokens, tools used)
        end

        Pipeline->>OTel: record metrics — sessions+1, exchanges+N, messages+N, tools+N, tokens+N, duration

        Pipeline->>Pipeline: GenerateMarkdownFromAgentSession()
        Pipeline->>Disk: os.WriteFile(TIMESTAMP-SLUG.md) — skips if content identical

        Pipeline->>OTel: span.End()
        OTel-->>Col: OTLP gRPC batched spans + metrics every 10s
    end

    Agent-->>CLI: exits
    CLI->>Watch: StopWatcher()
    CLI->>OTel: ForceFlush() + Shutdown() — ensures export before process exit
    OTel-->>Col: flush remaining spans + metrics
\```

---

## Data Flow: `specstory sync`  (Batch Post-processing)

\```mermaid
flowchart TD
    START([specstory sync]) --> DETECT

    DETECT["DetectAgent(projectPath)\nfor each registered provider"]
    DETECT -->|provider has sessions| LOAD
    DETECT -->|no activity| SKIP([skip provider])

    LOAD["GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath)\nparse ALL session files\nwith progress callback"]

    LOAD --> LOOP

    subgraph LOOP["For each AgentChatSession"]
        direction TB
        TRACE["telemetry.ContextWithSessionTrace()\ndeterministic TraceID\nfrom sessionID SHA-256"]
        SPAN["tracer.Start process_session\nset span attributes\nagent, sessionID, exchanges,\ntoolCount, tokenCounts"]
        CHILD["ProcessExchangeSpans()\nchild span per exchange\nmodel, promptTokens,\ncompletionTokens, tools"]
        METRICS["RecordSessionMetrics()\nsessions.processed +1\nexchanges, messages, tools +N\ntokens input/output/cache +N\nsession.duration histogram"]
        MDGEN["GenerateMarkdownFromAgentSession()\nrender structured SessionData\nto markdown string"]
        EXISTS{".md file\nalready exists?"}
        SAME{"content\nidentical?"}
        WRITE["os.WriteFile()\n.specstory/history/\nTIMESTAMP-SLUG.md"]
        NOOP["skip write\nup to date"]
        CLOUD["SyncSessionToCloud()\nPUT /api/v1/projects/ID/sessions/ID\nHEAD check first\noptional — skipped if not authed\nor --no-cloud-sync"]

        TRACE --> SPAN --> CHILD --> METRICS
        METRICS --> MDGEN --> EXISTS
        EXISTS -->|no| WRITE
        EXISTS -->|yes| SAME
        SAME -->|no — local is larger| WRITE
        SAME -->|yes| NOOP
        WRITE -.-> CLOUD
        NOOP -.-> CLOUD
    end

    LOOP --> FLUSH

    FLUSH["telemetry.ForceFlush()\ntelemetry.Shutdown()\nexport all pending\nspans + metrics"]

    FLUSH --> COL["OTLP Collector\nDatadog, Jaeger, Prometheus..."]

    style TRACE fill:#d4edda,stroke:#28a745
    style SPAN fill:#d4edda,stroke:#28a745
    style CHILD fill:#d4edda,stroke:#28a745
    style METRICS fill:#d4edda,stroke:#28a745
    style FLUSH fill:#d4edda,stroke:#28a745
    style COL fill:#d4edda,stroke:#28a745
    style CLOUD fill:#f8f9fa,stroke:#adb5bd,stroke-dasharray:4
    style WRITE fill:#cce5ff,stroke:#004085
    style NOOP fill:#cce5ff,stroke:#004085
\```
